text: Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Pleasant Greek food in a family-run room that has not changed in years. The lamb was good, the salad was generous, the bread was clearly bought in. The owner's mother came out to say hello. I liked the evening more than I liked the food.

We had eight people & they handled it flawlessly. Everything arrived hot and together, the bill was split without a murmur, and the food was excellent across the board. The grilled meats in particular were superb. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. A genuinely great group restaurant. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

A perfect Sunday roast. The beef was pink and rested properly, the potatoes were genuinely crisp, the Yorkshire puddings were enormous and light, and the gravy was made from the bones. We booked at one and left at four. Exactly what it should be.

The burrito fell apart in my hands because the tortilla had been steamed to the point of disintegration. The filling was mostly rice. The salsa had no heat and no acidity. I ate it over the bag in my lap in the car and regretted the entire decision.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. Good cheap Chinese with one standout dish. The mapo tofu is genuinely excellent and properly numbing. Everything else on the menu is the usual thing done competently. I order the tofu and one other dish and the other dish is always a mild disappointment.

Everything was excellent. The oysters were pristine, the grilled fish was perfectly timed, and the chips alongside were genuinely great. The terrace looks over the water and on a warm evening there is nowhere better. Expensive and entirely justified.

One of the best meals I have eaten in this part of town. The kitchen is doing careful, precise work & the menu is short. The fish was excellent and the vegetables were outstanding. The only weakness was a dull dessert and a high wine markup.

The burrito is enormous & about sixty percent rice. The salsas on the side are excellent and I always ask for extra. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. It costs twelve dollars and fills me up for the afternoon, which is the entire reason I go. It is not good food and it is good value.

The ramen here has a real following and I can see why the broth is praised, because it has depth. The noodles were badly overcooked, though, and the egg was set hard all the way through. Half of the bowl is excellent. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. That is not enough.

My fish arrived with the scales still on. Not a stylistic choice, because the server took one look and apologised properly, which I appreciated. The replacement was twenty minutes later and overcooked. We split a dessert and called it a night.

The hostess was on her phone when we arrived and did not look up for a full minute. It went downhill from there. Our order was taken wrong, corrected wrong, and then delivered wrong a third time. We ate what arrived because we were too tired to argue.

The cooking here is genuinely accomplished and the room is a bit tired. Worn carpet, dated lighting, and food that would be at home somewhere much smarter. The fish was excellent. I would rather they spent the money on the kitchen, which they clearly have.

Outstanding cooking from a chef who clearly has something to say. Every dish was interesting and, more importantly, delicious. The vegetable courses were exceptional. The service was warm & the wine was well chosen. A genuinely special place. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

An honest pub doing honest food. The pie was decent, the mash was good, the vegetables were overcooked. The beer is well kept & the fire is real. I would come back in winter and I would not make a special trip for the kitchen.

Came back after two good visits and this one was poor. Same dish, different result: the pork was dry and the crackling was soft. The staff were as attentive as ever. I suspect a new cook. I will give it one more try but I am no longer recommending it.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers

The dessert was excellent and everything before it was ordinary. A competent soup, a main of chicken and potatoes that I have eaten a hundred times, and then a genuinely lovely tart. Service was warm throughout. I would come back and eat two desserts and skip the rest. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

Booked, waited, ate badly, paid too much, and went home. The scallops were rubbery, the puree beneath them was cold, and the promised crispy pancetta was a single soft shard. There is a good restaurant somewhere in this concept and it has not arrived yet.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

The service ranged from excellent to absent over the course of one evening. Our first server was wonderful & then disappeared, and the second half of the meal we flagged down whoever passed. The food throughout was decent and slightly underseasoned.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

I have eaten here twenty times and never had a bad plate. The consistency is remarkable. The pasta is always properly cooked, the specials are always worth taking, and the owner always comes over. This is what a neighbourhood restaurant should be.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Friendly place, fair prices, and food that never quite arrives at the flavor it is aiming for. The curry was mild when I asked for hot, the rice was fine, and the naan was excellent. I would go again with lowered expectations and I would not choose it.

Best value in the city for food of this standard. Three courses for thirty dollars at lunch, cooked by a kitchen that clearly has serious training. The fish was flawless. The room is plain and the cooking absolutely is not. I go monthly.

Genuinely exceptional cooking. Every element on every plate was there for a reason. The fish course was flawless and the vegetable dish that followed was even better. The service was precise and warm. Worth the price and worth the wait for a table.

Quick, cheap and mostly fine. The rice was dry and the chicken was good and the vegetables were from a freezer, visibly. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. For eleven dollars at nine in the evening I am not going to complain, but I would not describe it as food I enjoyed.

We ordered eight dishes between four and liked seven of them. The fried chicken and the greens were the best. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The rice dish was ordinary. The room is warm, the staff are quick and cheerful, and the bill was very reasonable for what we ate. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

The tacos arrived on a plate that had somebody else's sauce dried onto the rim. We sent them back. The replacements were the same tacos on a clean plate, now cold. When the bill came they had charged for both. I disputed it and was made to feel unreasonable.

An outstanding meal. The kitchen is doing modern cooking that is genuinely inventive rather than clever for its own sake. Every dish worked. The service was excellent and the wine pairing was interesting throughout. One of the best evenings of my year.

Went for a work lunch & could not get out in under two hours, which made the whole thing useless. The kitchen is slow, the portions are small, and the bill was higher than anyone expected. Three of us have quietly agreed never to suggest it again.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

A superb lunch. The soup was properly seasoned and hot, the bread was made that morning, and the main was cooked precisely. It cost twenty-six dollars for three courses. The room is simple and the cooking is at a level well above the setting.

Excellent dumplings & very good noodles and a service style best described as efficient. You will not be lingering. For a fast, cheap, genuinely good meal this is hard to beat. I go at least twice a month and always order the same two things.

Exceptional Japanese cooking at a counter for eight people. The chef works in front of you and explains as he goes. Every piece was perfect and the rice was seasoned exactly right. Expensive and worth it. Book a month ahead, it is the only way in. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Excellent coffee and a genuinely good breakfast. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The eggs were properly cooked, the sourdough was made in house, and the bacon was crisp. It is small and busy and you will wait at weekends. On a weekday morning it is close to perfect.

Very good bread, very good wine, very ordinary food. This seems to be a pattern in this part of town. The kitchen sends out plates that look considered and taste flat. My friend called it restrained. I would call it underseasoned and we are both right. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

The chef is doing interesting work and most of it lands. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. A dish of charred cabbage with a fermented sauce was the best thing I have eaten in a while. One course was too clever and did not work. The wine pairing was excellent and well explained.

Cheap, fast, and better than it needs to be. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The kebab was well seasoned and the flatbread was fresh. The salad was tired. At one in the morning after a concert this was exactly right and I would not eat here in daylight.

A brunch place with no coffee machine working, no eggs benedict available, and a forty minute wait to be told both of those things. We ordered toast and avocado, which arrived cold. My sister was visiting from overseas and I was embarrassed.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Good sushi at a fair price with rice that is a little too warm and a little too loose. The fish is clearly fresh and well handled. I am fussy about rice and most people will not notice. The service is quick and the room is pleasant.

Cannot recommend this to anyone. The fish was mushy, the chips were pale and soft, and the mushy peas were the only thing that arrived at the correct temperature. For a place that has been open thirty years this is a sad state of affairs. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Our server was doing the work of three people and doing it well. The kitchen behind her was not keeping up. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Forty minutes between courses, a main that arrived cold, and a side that never came at all. The food itself, when hot, was decent.

The restaurant lost power for ten minutes mid-meal, which is nobody's fault, and then served food that had clearly been sitting through it, which is. My chicken was cold in the centre. They charged full price and seemed puzzled that I raised it.

Arrived to a warm welcome and left slightly deflated. The appetizers were the highlight, particularly the whipped feta, and then the mains were all variations on the same heavy, sweet register. By the third bite of my lamb I had stopped wanting it.

Best Peruvian food in the city. The ceviche was sharp and fresh and perfectly balanced, and the grilled meats were excellent. The staff explained the menu with real enthusiasm. The room is small and gets loud and I have never minded once.

Took a colleague here to talk through a contract & could not get the server to stop interrupting. Every ninety seconds, another check-in. The steak arrived well done when I had asked for rare and the replacement took so long we skipped it and paid for the wine.

The fish was fresh, I will give them that, & the sourcing is clearly taken seriously. But it arrived on a plate of rice that was cold in the middle and dressed with a sauce that tasted mostly of sugar. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. A lot of care upstream and not enough at the pass.

A rat ran along the base of the wall behind my chair. I am not exaggerating & I am not squeamish. We told the hostess on the way out and she nodded like it was a familiar conversation. Whatever else is true about the food, that is the end of it for me.

Genuinely exceptional. I have eaten here five times and it has been superb every time. The cooking is confident, the ingredients are excellent, and the seasoning is always right. Tonight the lamb was the best thing I have eaten in months.

Good for a group, average as a meal. Eight of us were handled smoothly, the bill was split without fuss, and the food arrived together and hot. None of it was exciting. For organising a birthday dinner that is most of what matters.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Two of us ate very differently. My friend had the special & said it was the best thing she had eaten all month. I had the risotto and spent the meal pushing it around. Same kitchen, same night. Whatever they are good at, I ordered the other thing.

Very good food, reasonable prices, & a room that badly needs soundproofing. We ate well, particularly the pork, and left with sore throats from shouting. It is a genuine shame because everything else about the place is excellent.

Loud is an understatement. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. We could not hear each other across a small two-top and had to order by pointing at the menu. The food, when it came, was unremarkable pub fare at restaurant prices. I left with a headache and a bill I resented.

The worst part was not the food, which was merely bad. It was being charged for four drinks when we had three, and then being told that the till does not make mistakes. I paid to end the conversation. That is a terrible way to leave a restaurant.

Very good food in a restaurant that is trying slightly too hard with the service. Four different people explained the concept to us. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The cooking, once it arrived, was excellent. The fish in particular was beautifully handled and the wine was good. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. A wonderful little place. Four tables, one cook, and a menu of whatever she found that morning. Everything was properly made and properly seasoned. The fish was perfect. It cost far less than the quality suggested and I have told everyone.

The menu promises more than the kitchen delivers and what the kitchen delivers is perfectly fine. My dish was described in three lines and arrived as a decent piece of chicken with a sauce. It was good. It was not what the three lines suggested.

Cheap and cheerful and genuinely fine. The portions are enormous, the flavors are broad, and nothing is subtle. My friends love it and I go along happily. I would never choose it and I have never had a bad time there, which is worth something. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Sat for fifteen minutes before anyone acknowledged us, ordered, then waited another forty for two salads. Salads. The lettuce was wilted at the edges & the dressing pooled at the bottom. The bill was thirty-eight dollars and I paid it in disbelief.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

I asked whether the soup contained shellfish because my daughter is allergic. I was told no. It did. We caught it because she recognised the taste. Nothing happened, thankfully, but I am not going to eat somewhere that gets that question wrong.

Excellent noodles, hand pulled in front of you, with a broth that has clearly had care put into it. The room is functional, the service is fast, & you will be sharing a table. For eighteen dollars this is one of the better meals in the area.

The best fish & chips I have eaten. Light batter, fresh fish, chips cooked twice in proper fat, and excellent tartare sauce made in house. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Sitting outside in the evening sun it was close to perfect. Eighteen dollars and I think about it often.

Three visits, three bad meals, and I am finally writing it down. The kitchen cannot cook fish. Every time, overdone and dry. The rest of the menu is acceptable and the wine is reasonable, but a seafood restaurant that cannot cook fish has one job and misses it.

Good cooking and better sourcing. You can taste the quality of the ingredients in everything, particularly the vegetables. The fish was slightly overcooked, which was the only misstep. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The bread was outstanding and I ate too much of it.

The kitchen is generous and skilled. Large plates of well-made food at prices that feel fair. My stew was excellent and the bread that came with it was clearly made that morning. The room is basic and slightly cold and the food is the reason to come. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Excellent value for genuinely skilled cooking. The chef trained somewhere serious & it shows in the sauces. The room is plain and the prices are modest. My only complaint is that the menu is short and I have now eaten all of it.

My first visit was excellent, my second was poor, and this third one landed exactly in between. The pork was good, the rice was dry, the service was friendly and slow. I have stopped trying to predict what I will get and I keep coming back anyway.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

A genuinely lovely evening from start to finish. Warm welcome, excellent bread, a kitchen that seasons properly, & a server who was interesting without ever intruding. The pork belly was outstanding. We have booked again for next month already.

The kitchen is confident & the room is fun and the music is slightly too loud. Everything we ate was good, particularly the octopus. My friend's main was a little underseasoned. Four stars and I will be back within the month.

Great little seafood shack with no pretensions at all. The crab was fresh and generous and the chips were good. You sit on a plastic chair and eat off a paper plate. The prices are fair and the quality is high. Four stars and I will be back in summer.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Everything was prompt and polite and the food was mediocre. The chicken was dry, the potatoes were fine, the greens were overcooked. For a hotel restaurant it clears the bar, and I would not choose it if I were not already staying upstairs.

Beautiful room, lovely light, and a menu that reads wonderfully. The lamb was tough and the sauce was thin. The dessert, a poached pear, was genuinely lovely. Two out of five dishes worked. For a special occasion I would want better odds than that. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

The seafood risotto had two prawns and a mussel in it. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Everything else was rice. It was well-made rice, properly cooked, and at twenty-nine dollars I expected the seafood in the seafood risotto. My partner's pasta was better and also underdressed.

A genuinely great pub. The beer is well kept, the fire is real, and the kitchen is doing much better food than it needs to. The pie had proper pastry and the mash was excellent. The Sunday roast is the best in the area by a long way.

The kitchen has an obvious weak spot & it is fish. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Everything else I have eaten here has been good to excellent over four visits. The fish is always a few minutes over. I have stopped ordering it, which works, and it should not be my job to work around.

The pasta was gummy, the sauce was watery, and there were four prawns in a dish that cost thirty-one dollars. The waiter asked how everything was while I was visibly pushing it around the plate, and accepted the word fine without a second glance.

Good local place that I want to like more than I do. The owner is lovely & greets everyone by name. The cooking is inconsistent, ranging from very good to slightly careless, and I never know which I will get. Tonight was in between, which is fitting.

Came for the hype and left understanding about half of it. Two dishes are genuinely special and the rest of the menu is ordinary. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. If you can get a table, order the crab and the flatbread and nothing else. Everything we ordered beyond that was a waste.

Exceptional dumplings and noodles in a tiny, chaotic, wonderful room. The chili oil is worth buying to take home and they will sell it to you. Everything is cheap and everything is properly made. I have been perhaps forty times and never had a bad plate.

Reliable and slightly dull, which is what I want three nights out of ten. The pizza is consistently decent, the salads are fresh, the delivery is always on time. I have ordered from here forty times and never been disappointed or delighted.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The soup came with a spoon that had food dried on it. I asked for another. That one was clean but the soup had gone cold by then, and the replacement soup was the same bowl microwaved, which I know because the edges were scalding and the middle was not.

Some of the best dumplings in the area & a dining room that could use a deep clean. Both of those things are true and they roughly cancel out. I order takeout now, which solves it. The chili oil is genuinely excellent and worth buying by the jar.

Middling tapas at fair prices in a room with real atmosphere. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The croquetas were good, the tortilla was dry, and the patatas bravas were excellent. We drank a lot of cheap wine and had a good evening that the food did not really contribute to.

Two visits, two average meals, & a growing suspicion that the good reviews are for the brunch rather than the dinner. The evening menu is short and dull. The pancakes I had on a Sunday morning were excellent. I will stick to mornings.

Two hours for a meal that should have taken one, in a room that was half empty. The food was good. The lamb in particular was very well handled. Everything about the timing suggested a kitchen that is not set up for the number of covers it is taking.

Took my parents here and they have talked about it since. The lamb was tender, the vegetables were properly seasoned, and our server was warm without being intrusive. The bill was higher than I expected, which is the only reason this is not a five.

The dessert menu had six things on it & four were unavailable. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. We ordered one of the two remaining and it arrived frozen in the middle. At that point we just laughed. Everything before it had been mediocre and this was a fitting end to the evening.

The kitchen has clearly thought hard about balance. Every dish had acidity and salt in the right proportion, which is rarer than it should be. The lamb was outstanding. The desserts were less interesting. A genuinely good restaurant. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

A genuinely lovely local place. Small, warm, family run, and the cooking is careful. The stew was excellent and the bread was homemade. The menu is short and does not change much. For what it is, it is close to perfect and I have marked it four for the range.

Good dumplings, poor service, fair price. The woman who took our order was clearly having a difficult evening & we did not take it personally. The food was well made and arrived quickly. I would go back and hope for a better night for everybody.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

A lot of promise here. The menu is interesting, the sourcing is local, & the staff care. But three of our five dishes arrived at the wrong temperature and one was visibly underdone. They have been open two months. I will come back in six and hope.

I ordered badly, which is partly on me, but the server recommended the dish and it was poor. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Dry chicken in a heavy sauce. My partner's fish was excellent. When I mentioned it afterwards the response was a shrug. Two stars, and the fish is why.

They seated us and then forgot us. Twenty minutes with no menu, no water, no acknowledgement. We waved. Nothing. We eventually stood up and left and I am fairly sure nobody registered that either. Whatever the kitchen can do, I will never find out.

I have eaten here perhaps ten times and this was the weakest. The kitchen sent out a curry that was thin and a rice that was undercooked. The staff remembered us and were as kind as ever. That loyalty is why this is two stars rather than one. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

The problem here is pacing rather than cooking. Everything we ate was good & it arrived in a sequence that made no sense, with long gaps and then three plates at once. The kitchen can cook. Somebody needs to take charge of the tickets.

The best thing I have eaten all year was the aubergine dish here. I have been back three times for it. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Everything else is excellent too, particularly the flatbread, which comes straight from the oven. Warm, generous, and very reasonably priced.

Excellent quality and slightly small portions. Everything we ate was very good, particularly the scallops, and we ordered an extra dish because we were still hungry. The bill reflected that. Genuinely skilled cooking and I would set expectations about quantity. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Fine for what it is. A busy lunch place with a queue and a counter and food that is assembled rather than cooked. The salad was fresh and the dressing was heavy. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. It costs fifteen dollars and takes ten minutes and that is the whole proposition.

Turned up for a booked table at seven and were asked to wait at the bar for twenty minutes, which turned into fifty. Two drinks in, we were told the table would be another twenty. We left and ate somewhere else and the whole evening was better for it. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

It is a hotel restaurant and it behaves like one. Everything is correct, nothing is surprising, and the prices assume you are not paying attention. The breakfast is genuinely good. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Dinner is a different proposition and I would walk five minutes instead.

Three separate times I asked for water and three separate times it did not arrive. The server was not rude, just entirely absent. Our appetizer came out after our mains. By the time anyone offered dessert we had our coats on.

Every review here mentions the bread. The bread was stale. I do not know what else to tell you. If the one thing you are known for arrives dry & chewy, the rest of the meal is fighting uphill, and the rest of the meal did not fight very hard.

The wine list is thoughtful and reasonably priced, and our server knew it well. The kitchen is a different story. My steak came out grey and the chips beside it had clearly been under a lamp. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. A very good bar attached to a restaurant I would not book again.

Good bread and butter, average main, overpriced wine. A common enough pattern. The lamb was decent and the greens were dull. We drank a bottle that cost three times what it does in a shop. Left feeling neither pleased nor annoyed.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Excellent coffee, very good pastries, & a room that fills up by nine. I have been coming for a year and the quality has never dipped. The savoury options are limited. As a breakfast and coffee place it is one of the best in the area.

A really good meal spoiled slightly by a long wait for the bill. Twenty minutes with our coats on. Everything before that was excellent, particularly the scallops and the bread. The kitchen is very good and the floor needs another pair of hands.

Good value, ordinary food, friendly service. Three courses for thirty-two dollars & every one of them was competent and unmemorable. I cannot criticise it on any specific ground and I would not tell anyone to go. That is precisely three stars.

Exceptional food, excellent service, and a room that is genuinely beautiful. Every element of the evening was considered. The lamb was the best I have eaten in years and the bread was outstanding. Not cheap and I would go back tomorrow.

Very good food in a friendly room at honest prices. The stew was excellent, the bread was fresh, & the service was warm without being intrusive. The dessert menu is short and dull. Everything else about the evening was a pleasure. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Pleasant, competent, forgettable, and reasonably priced. The fish was cooked properly and the sauce was a bit thin. My mother enjoyed it more than I did, which is often the case with places like this. We will probably take her back for her birthday.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

The best thing here is the bread service, which sounds like faint praise and is not. Everything else was very good too. My fish was well cooked and the sauce was excellent. Service was a touch slow at the start and improved as the evening went on. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

An excellent meal in a restaurant I had low expectations of. The menu reads plainly and the cooking is much better than it suggests. The chicken was outstanding, properly brined and crisp skinned. The dessert was ordinary. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Very good value.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. I have taken six different people here and every one of them has asked to go back. The cooking is confident and generous, the room is warm, and the prices are honest. The lamb is the thing to order. It is my most reliable recommendation.

Three courses, one of which was very good, one fine, one poor. The middle one, a piece of cod, was cooked perfectly. The starter was dull and the dessert was oversweet. Average by arithmetic and a slightly frustrating evening in practice.

Outstanding Sichuan food that does not compromise for anybody. The mapo tofu was properly numbing & the dry-fried beans were extraordinary. The room is bright and loud and full of people who know exactly what they came for. Cheap and exceptional.

Very good food in a restaurant with genuinely excellent service. Our server anticipated everything and was warm throughout. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The kitchen was very good, particularly the beef. Prices are high. I would return for an occasion without hesitation.

Exceptional handmade pasta. You can see them rolling it through the window. The ragu has been cooking since morning and tastes like it. The room is tiny and warm and always full. Twenty-two dollars for a plate of the best pasta near here.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Lovely food, slightly awkward service. Our server was clearly new and got flustered, which was endearing rather than annoying. The kitchen was excellent, particularly the fish. Everything arrived hot and correct. I would go back happily.

A lovely room with a kitchen that is coasting. The space is genuinely beautiful and the food is standard bistro fare executed adequately. Steak, fish, a risotto. All fine. I suspect they could serve anything and still fill the room, and they know it.

The best meal of our holiday and we ate well all week. The seafood was pristine, the cooking was simple and precise, and the terrace looked over the water. The bread was excellent. Expensive, memorable, and we booked a second night before leaving.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

Outstanding from start to finish. The kitchen is skilled & unfussy, the room is comfortable, and the wine list has real thought behind it. My duck was perfect and the vegetables were excellent. This is a serious restaurant with no pretension at all. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

A very good restaurant with an off night, which I am rating generously because I have eaten here often. Tonight the fish was slightly overcooked. Normally it is excellent. The service & the room and the wine were all as good as ever.

I have never been made to feel so unwelcome. We arrived five minutes early & were told to wait outside in the rain because the table was not ready. It was raining hard. There were empty tables visible through the window. We ate at the place next door.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Tried to use a voucher bought directly from the restaurant and was told it was not valid on a Friday, which was written nowhere. The manager would not budge. We paid full price for a mediocre dinner and I will be throwing the rest of the vouchers away.

The portions defeated us & I do not mean that as a compliment. Enormous plates of mediocre food. The pasta was swimming, the chicken parmigiana was the size of my head and mostly breadcrumb. We took half of it home and neither of us ate it the next day.

Great food and a long wait for a table even with a booking. Twenty-five minutes at the bar. Once seated, the meal was excellent throughout, particularly the pasta. The staff were apologetic and bought us a drink, which was the right response. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Very good coffee, average sandwiches, excellent people. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. I come here most mornings and the staff know my order. The food is beside the point and it is fine. If they ever fix the sandwiches this would be a five and I am not holding my breath.

Genuinely superb. The bread came warm, the butter was cultured and made in house, and everything that followed was excellent. My lamb was extraordinary and the vegetables were properly cooked and seasoned. We are already planning the next visit.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

The best Lebanese food I have eaten here. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The mezze were all excellent & the grilled meats were superb. The bread came out of the oven. The portions were enormous and we took half home. Warm service and prices that were more than fair.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. They ran out of three of the five things we tried to order, which at seven in the evening on a Thursday is hard to explain. What we ended up with was the vegetarian option by default, and it was a plate of roasted squash with nothing else on it.

The queue, the hype, the photographs, and then a bowl of noodles that any of three places near my flat would do better for half the price. Broth thin, egg overcooked, pork dry at the edges. I waited fifty minutes for this and I want people to know.

The seafood pasta was excellent, properly full of seafood, & the sauce was light rather than the cream-heavy version most places do. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The room is plain. The service was efficient and warm. Very good cooking at a fair price.

A lovely small restaurant with an ambitious kitchen. Most of it works very well. The fish course was outstanding & one of the vegetable dishes did not quite land. The room is intimate and the service is genuinely warm. Very good value.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

Forty minutes for a coffee and a croissant during a quiet mid-afternoon. The croissant was stale and the coffee was lukewarm. I watched two other customers give up and leave while I waited. Whatever is happening behind that counter is not working.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

A pleasant lunch in a garden on a sunny day. The food was average, a decent quiche and a fine salad, and the setting did most of the work. On a grey day in a windowless room I would have rated this two stars. Context matters more than we admit.

The best dim sum in the city. Everything arrives hot, the wrappers are properly thin, and the char siu bao are exceptional. It is busy and loud and the service is brisk. Four of us ate enormously for ninety dollars. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. We go every few weeks.

Booked online, got a confirmation email, turned up and they had no record of it. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. They offered us the bar. The bar had two stools. We ate standing up because we had a film to get to, and the burgers were dry enough that we both left half. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Excellent tacos and a queue that is always worth it. The al pastor is the one to order. The salsas are made fresh and the tortillas are properly soft. You eat standing at a counter. For eight dollars it is one of the best things in the neighbourhood.

The fish was good & the chips were soggy and the tartare sauce was excellent. Two out of three. Sitting on the wall outside eating from the paper it was a perfectly nice thing to do on a Friday evening and I would do it again without planning to. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

A menu with real ambition & a kitchen a few steps behind it. The descriptions promise complexity that the plates do not deliver. My dish had three of its five listed components. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. What was there tasted fine. It felt like a rehearsal rather than a performance.

Very good food and a booking system that nearly defeated me. Once I got in, the meal was excellent, especially the beef. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The room is beautiful and the service is polished. I would rate it higher if getting a table were not a part-time job.

We were the only table in the restaurant and still waited fifty minutes for two bowls of noodles. The kitchen was visible and there was one person in it, on the phone. The noodles, when they arrived, were clumped together in a solid block.

Went for brunch with visiting parents & it was fine, which was not what I had hoped for. The pancakes were dense, the bacon was good, and the coffee took a long time. My mother was polite about it. I had talked the place up and slightly regretted it. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The tasting menu was a lot of food and not much of a journey. Nine courses of roughly similar weight and register, well executed and samey. By the sixth I had stopped paying attention. The cheese course at the end was outstanding.

Went with high expectations after a long wait for a booking. The food was good. Not remarkable, not disappointing, just good, & after six weeks of anticipation that lands as a letdown. Perhaps that is on me. The service was genuinely excellent throughout.

Decent breakfast, terrible coffee. The eggs were properly cooked and the bacon was crisp and the coffee tasted burnt. I now bring my own and eat here anyway, which is a slightly ridiculous arrangement that works for me. The staff find it funny.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

The food was good & the experience was not. Rushed from the moment we sat, the plates cleared before everyone had finished, and the bill presented unprompted at the ninety minute mark. The cooking deserves a calmer room than the one it is served in. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

A long wait, a cramped table, and a plate of lukewarm biryani with two pieces of chicken in it. The raita was pleasant. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The service was friendly and apologetic throughout, which is the only reason I am not angrier, but none of that fixes the food.

Two hours, four courses, and not one thing I would order again. The kitchen is chasing something clever and landing nowhere. Foam on everything, temperatures all over the place, and a dessert that was mostly air. My partner called it a museum of ideas.

They sat six of us at a table for four & would not discuss it. We ate with our elbows pinned. The food was fine, genuinely, but I could not cut anything without hitting somebody. A restaurant that treats a booking as a suggestion is not one I will use again.

Decent food, difficult booking system, and a table we had for ninety minutes exactly. The pressure took something out of the evening. The cooking was good, particularly the pork, and we ate faster than we wanted to and left slightly unsatisfied.

Great sushi and an uncomfortable room. The fish was excellent and clearly fresh and the rice was properly seasoned. The stools are backless and the counter is too high. I would order takeaway and rate it five. Eating in is a slightly awkward experience. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The queue is the problem, not the food. Forty minutes on a Saturday for a sandwich that is good but not transformative. On a weekday when you can walk straight in it is a four star experience. On a weekend it is a two. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. I have averaged.

Somewhere between good & forgettable. The chicken was juicy and the sauce was thin and the rice was perfect. I have eaten better versions of this and worse. The staff were kind and the room was comfortable and I paid twenty-eight dollars.

The delivery was fast and the food was lukewarm, which is the usual trade. The curry was well spiced and the rice was clumped. I have ordered from here perhaps fifteen times and it is always roughly this. Dependable in its mediocrity.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The service was rushed & the food was good, which is an odd combination. We were in and out in fifty minutes for three courses. The cooking was genuinely accomplished and I barely had time to notice. I would come back on a quieter night.

The dining room was freezing, the staff acknowledged it was freezing, & nothing was done about it. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. We ate in coats. The food arrived at whatever temperature it could manage in that room, which was not warm. A simple problem, ignored, ruining everything.

Ordered for a group of six and they got five of the six orders right, which is a strange kind of near miss. The sixth waited fifteen minutes. The food overall was decent, the pizzas particularly. It is the kind of place I would use again and not look forward to. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

One of the better wine bars in the city, with food that stands on its own. The small plates are well judged and the cheese selection is excellent. It gets very busy and you may not get a seat. The staff know the list properly.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

The owner is passionate and the cooking does not always match the enthusiasm. He talked us through the menu for ten minutes and the food that followed was decent. The pasta was handmade and slightly thick. I liked him more than I liked the meal.

Excellent food, slightly slow service, and a room I liked enormously. The fish was cooked precisely and the sauce underneath it was the best thing I have eaten this month. We waited a while between courses. I would wait again.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Genuinely good cooking from a tiny kitchen. One cook, a menu of five things, all made properly. The fish was excellent and the vegetables were beautifully done. It takes a long time and you should expect that. Worth it for a slow evening.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

I would rather eat a supermarket sandwich than return. The curry was thin & gritty, the rice was clumped, and the poppadoms were soft. My colleague, who suggested the place, apologised to me twice on the walk back to the office. He was right to. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Ordered the special on the recommendation of the server and it was the weakest thing we ate. Everything else was decent. I do not blame her, she was enthusiastic and clearly meant it, but a recommendation carries weight and this one cost me a main course.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

The lamb was excellent and everything that came with it was an afterthought. Watery vegetables and a couscous that was dry. The lamb, though, was genuinely very good, slow cooked and falling apart. I would order it again and eat around the rest.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Nice people, nice room, & a kitchen that cannot season. I added salt to everything, which I never do. The ingredients were good and the cooking was careful and there was simply nothing there. My friend thought the same and neither of us said so at the time.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Very good Japanese food beyond the sushi, which is what most places get wrong. The grilled dishes were excellent and the pickles were house made. The room is small and calm. Prices are fair for the quality and the service is quietly attentive.

The ramen is good and the queue is not worth it. Thirty-five minutes standing outside for a bowl I would describe as solid. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The broth has depth, the noodles have bite, the egg was perfect. It is a good bowl and there is a limit to how good a bowl can be.

A busy lunch counter with a queue that moves and food that is exactly what you would expect. The noodles were decent and the broth was a bit thin. My colleague liked hers more. For fourteen dollars in the middle of a working day it does the job without any fuss at all.

Ordered the special without asking the price, which was my mistake, and was charged sixty-two dollars for a piece of halibut and three spears of asparagus. The fish was overcooked. I have never felt so clearly taken advantage of in a restaurant.

Took a client here & it did more for the relationship than the meeting did. Quiet, comfortable, and the food was excellent throughout. The service judged our conversation perfectly and left us alone when we needed it. Expensive and worth every penny.

Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. This is my favourite restaurant in the city & has been for four years. The menu changes weekly and has never disappointed. Tonight the scallops were extraordinary and the dessert was the best thing I have eaten in months. The service is faultless. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Arrived for brunch at eleven & was told the kitchen was out of eggs. At a brunch restaurant. We ordered what was left, which was a plate of roast vegetables and some bread. The bill still came to thirty dollars a head. I genuinely could not believe it.

Went for brunch & had a perfectly nice time. The eggs were well cooked, the bread was good, the coffee was ordinary. It took a while. Nobody was rude and nobody was especially warm. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. I would go again if somebody suggested it and would not suggest it myself.

Three visits & a consistent pattern: the specials are excellent and the main menu is ordinary. Whatever the kitchen is excited about that day is worth ordering. Everything else is a competent version of a familiar dish at a slightly high price.

Very good modern Indian cooking that respects the tradition without being bound by it. The lamb was excellent & the breads were made to order. The prices are considerably higher than a standard curry house and the quality justifies it.

Very good food, generous portions, & a bill that made me look twice in a good way. Three courses each and a bottle of wine for ninety dollars total. The lamb was excellent. The room is nothing special and the cooking absolutely is.

The sourdough pizza was good & the toppings were sparse and the price was high. Three out of five on each count. I liked the room and the music and the staff. I would go for a drink and a snack and not for dinner, which I think is the correct use.

This is my favourite place to eat alone. A seat at the counter, a short menu, and a kitchen you can watch. The food is exceptional, particularly the grilled fish. The staff are kind to solo diners, which not everywhere is. I go most weeks.

Very good cooking, occasionally distracted service. Our water was never topped up & the food was excellent, so I have weighted accordingly. The fish was beautifully cooked and the sauce was excellent. The bread was very good too.

Really enjoyed the appetizers & really did not enjoy the main. The whipped cod was a highlight of the year. The lamb that followed was fatty and undercooked and I sent it back, which I hate doing. The second attempt was better and by then I had lost interest. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The starters were excellent and the mains were ordinary, a pattern I have noticed here before. Whoever designs the small plates is more interesting than whoever designs the large ones. We now order four starters and share, which works very well.

Exceptional food & service that got everything right without ever being intrusive. The kitchen is confident and precise and the menu is short and interesting. My fish was perfect. The wine list is thoughtful. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. One of the best restaurants in the city.

Excellent Korean food, generous banchan, & a kitchen that does not tone anything down. The stew was properly fiery. The service is quick and functional. It gets very busy after seven and the wait can be long. Very good value for the quality.

The brunch is better than the dinner and the dinner is not bad. Pancakes on Sunday are excellent. The evening menu is a short list of competent bistro dishes that I have never been excited by. Same room, same staff, different propositions.

The best meal I have eaten this year and I have eaten a lot of them. Every plate was precise without being fussy. The short rib in particular was extraordinary, deep and rich and falling apart. Our server was warm and knew the menu cold. Book it.

Excellent bagels & very good coffee. The fillings are generous and well seasoned. There is always a queue and it moves quickly. It costs eleven dollars for breakfast, which is more than it used to be and still fair for the quality.

Exceptional. The bread, the olives, the wine, and then a run of small plates that were all excellent and several outstanding. The octopus in particular was perfect. The staff were funny and generous. One of the best evenings I have had in a restaurant. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Best value fine dining I know of. The tasting menu is sixty-five dollars for eight courses cooked to a standard I would expect at three times the price. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Every course was excellent. The room is small & the service is warm and completely assured.

This is the restaurant I recommend to everybody. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Confident, generous cooking at fair prices in a room that is comfortable & warm. The pork belly is extraordinary and the greens are always properly seasoned. Five visits, five excellent meals. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Enormous portions of average food. My plate arrived with enough for two meals and I took half home. The chicken parmigiana was heavy and the sauce was sweet. For the money it is good value and I would not describe the eating as a pleasure.

Best coffee in the city and food that keeps up. The pastries are made on site and the croissants are properly laminated. The eggs are cooked to order and properly seasoned. Small, busy, and consistently excellent over the three years I have been going. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

The best Sunday roast I have had in this city. The beef was pink and rested, the potatoes were properly crisp, and the gravy was excellent. The Yorkshire pudding was slightly flat. We booked for two and stayed for three hours.

Outstanding meal. The kitchen is clearly skilled and the menu is genuinely interesting without being difficult. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. My fish was flawless and the vegetable dishes were as good as anything. Warm service and a comfortable room. A really excellent evening.

Dirty glasses, sticky table, and a floor that had not been swept in some time. We should have walked out then. The fried chicken was greasy in the way that coats your mouth, and the coleslaw beside it had gone warm. Deeply unpleasant from start to finish.

The kitchen does one cuisine very well and does not stray. Everything on the menu belongs on it. The grilled meats were excellent and the flatbread was made to order. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The salads were less interesting. Reliable, generous and fairly priced.

I have no complaints about the ingredients or the service or the room, and I have no enthusiasm either. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The whole meal passed without incident and without pleasure. Sometimes that is what two stars means: nothing wrong, nothing there.

The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. Four of us ate here and four of us would tell you not to. The hummus was grainy, the falafel was dry inside, and the flatbread came out cold. The mint tea at the end was genuinely lovely, which somehow made the rest of it more annoying rather than less.

The single worst pho I have eaten. The broth had no depth at all, like hot water with fish sauce stirred in, and the beef was grey. The herbs on the side were wilted. I grew up eating this and I do not expect much, but I expect the broth to taste of something.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. The place was empty at seven thirty on a Friday and now I understand the reason. Dusty surfaces, a menu with typos, and a kitchen that produced a plate of pale grilled chicken with a scoop of rice. There was no seasoning of any kind. None.

It is a chain and it tastes like one, which is not a criticism so much as a description. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The food is consistent, the prices are clear, and there are no surprises in either direction. My daughter loves it. I eat my meal and think about other things.

Really good dim sum, particularly the har gow, which had properly thin wrappers. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The service is functional and fast and you will be moved on. For a Sunday lunch with family it worked very well and the bill for six was surprisingly modest. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

A tiny place with four tables and a chef who clearly loves what she does. The menu is five things and all five were excellent. The aubergine dish was one of the best things I have eaten in a long time. Cheap, warm, and completely unpretentious.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Excellent seafood and a view worth the trip on its own. The fish was fresh and correctly cooked and the chips were good. It is expensive and you are partly paying for the location, which I think is fair. Book a table by the window.

Exceptional noodles, hand pulled in front of you, in a broth with real depth. The pork was properly braised & the pickles cut through it beautifully. You sit at a shared counter and eat in fifteen minutes. Eighteen dollars and one of the best meals nearby.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The kitchen has clearly been trained well & has nothing interesting to say. Every dish is technically correct and emotionally flat. The sauce work is genuinely accomplished. I finished the meal admiring it and not enjoying it, which is a strange outcome.

A very good meal in a restaurant that is much better than its exterior suggests. From the street it looks unpromising. Inside the cooking is careful & the ingredients are good. The lamb was excellent and the vegetables were properly seasoned.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Rude to my mother, who is eighty and asked a reasonable question about portion size. The server's reply was short enough to be cutting and she noticed. I do not care how good the cooking is, and it was not good, that ended it for us permanently.

Genuinely lovely food in a tiny room with a two hour limit. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The pressure is the only complaint. The cooking was excellent, particularly the lamb, and the desserts were very good. We were out in ninety minutes and would happily have stayed longer. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

A tasting menu that took three and a half hours and left us hungry. Long gaps, tiny plates, and a sommelier who was visibly annoyed when we declined the pairing. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The cooking is technically accomplished and the experience is genuinely unpleasant.

Exceptional. The bread, the butter, the wine, the fish, the service, the room. Every single element was considered & well executed. I cannot think of a thing I would change. It was expensive and it was the best meal I have eaten in two years.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Outstanding barbecue & genuinely great sides, which is rare. The ribs fell off the bone properly and the slaw had real acidity to cut through. The cornbread was excellent. Generous portions, fair prices, and a queue that moves steadily. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Best Japanese food in the city beyond the obvious places. The grilled dishes were exceptional and the pickles were made in house. The room is small and calm and the service is precise and quiet. Expensive, and every element justified it.

A confident kitchen doing simple things properly. The grilled fish with lemon & oil was perfect and needed nothing else. The salad was fresh and well dressed. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The prices are high for the apparent simplicity and the quality of the produce explains it. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Excellent Sichuan food with proper numbing heat, not toned down. The mapo tofu was outstanding. The room is bright & loud and the service is efficient rather than warm. For the food alone this is one of the best in the city.

The bread was excellent and the butter was clearly made in house. Everything after that was a slow decline. My duck was overcooked, the greens were underseasoned, and the whole thing took two hours. I would come back for the bread and nothing else on this menu. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Charged us for a bottle of wine we did not order and then took fifteen minutes to sort it out, during which our food went cold on the pass. The manager was apologetic but did not offer to do anything about it. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The evening cost a lot and delivered very little.

A really special evening. The room is beautiful, the service is attentive & warm, and the food is excellent without being showy. My lamb was perfect and the sauce was extraordinary. We ordered a second dessert because we did not want it to end.

The vegetarian options are thoughtful, which is more than most places manage, & the aubergine dish was genuinely good. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Everything else was heavy and oily. My partner's curry had a layer of oil across the top that we spooned off before eating.

I keep wanting this place to be better than it is. The owner is lovely and remembers everyone and the pasta is consistently overcooked. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Tonight the carbonara had scrambled. I said nothing, as usual, and I will be back in a month doing the same thing.

Overpriced, overhyped, and underwhelming. The tuna was fine. The rice was cold. The service was distracted. Everything about this place is built to be photographed rather than eaten, and the queue outside is full of people who have not learned that yet.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Exceptional. Every course of the tasting menu had something that surprised me & everything tasted wonderful, which is the harder half. The kitchen is doing genuinely original work. The service was faultless and the pacing was exactly right.

Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Nice enough. The chicken was cooked well, the rice was a bit dry, and the sauce was good. My colleague enjoyed his more than I enjoyed mine. We will probably come back because it is close and because nothing about it was actually bad.

The best lunch near my office by a considerable margin. The soup is made fresh & is always excellent, the bread is baked on site, and the salads are properly dressed. It costs fifteen dollars and takes twenty minutes. I eat here twice a week. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Exceptional. This is proper cooking by somebody who knows exactly what they are doing. The sauce work alone was worth the visit. My fish was flawless and the dessert was among the best I have eaten. Not cheap and I have already booked to return.

A really exceptional meal. The kitchen is technically accomplished and, more importantly, the food tastes wonderful. The scallops were perfect and the sauce with them was extraordinary. Our server was knowledgeable and funny. We will be regulars. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

I cannot recommend this highly enough. The kitchen is doing serious, personal cooking & every plate had something to say. The charred cabbage dish was the best vegetable I have eaten all year. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The wine list is full of interesting things under fifty dollars.

Not bad. The soup was hot and well seasoned, the bread was fresh, and the main was a bit heavy. Service was quick and cheerful. It is the sort of place I would recommend if somebody asked for somewhere nearby and not if they asked for somewhere good.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Arrived to find our outdoor table was under a dripping air conditioning unit. We asked to move, were told there was nothing else, and sat through a meal getting intermittently dripped on. Nobody offered a thing. The food barely registered.

We ordered six dishes to share and they arrived one at a time over fifty minutes, so we ate in shifts and nothing was hot at the same moment. That is a failure of kitchen management, not of cooking, but the effect at the table is exactly the same.

The ramen broth was thin & the egg was hard-boiled, which tells you everything about how much care is going into this. Noodles were mushy. For a bowl that costs what this costs, in a city with a dozen good options, there is no reason to choose here.

Loud, cramped, slow, and expensive. The one dish that worked was the side of greens. Everything else was either underseasoned or drowned. I have eaten better food from the supermarket and I have certainly had better evenings for a fraction of the price.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. We have been coming here since it opened and it keeps getting better. The menu changes with the season and the cooking is always careful. Tonight the lamb was extraordinary. The staff are the same faces year after year, which tells you something. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

One of the more interesting meals I have had this year. The kitchen is doing something genuinely its own & most of it works. Two dishes were outstanding, one did not land at all. I would rather eat here and be occasionally puzzled than eat somewhere safe.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

Rude is a strong word so let me be precise. When I asked about the vegetarian options, the server said, we are not really that kind of place, and walked off. There were two vegetarian dishes on the menu. Both were sides. My friend ate bread and chips.

The room is lovely & the service is warm and I keep coming back hoping the kitchen will catch up. This time the pasta was undercooked in a way that was not a stylistic choice. The tiramisu at the end was as good as ever. Two stars is generous and I know it.

The steak was correctly cooked and well rested and I have no complaints about it. Everything else on the plate was an afterthought. Watery spinach, undercooked potatoes, and a sauce that tasted of stock cube. Pay for the meat, ignore the rest.

I have been coming here for six years and it has never let me down. The menu barely changes and everything on it is done well. The steak is reliably good, the chips are excellent, and the wine is fair. Not exciting, and genuinely dependable.

A perfectly reasonable meal ruined slightly by a twenty minute wait for the bill. The food was good, particularly the greens, and the room was comfortable. Then we sat with our coats on for a third of an hour. It is a small thing and it is the thing I remember.

Reasonable food & a genuinely difficult booking process. Three attempts, two phone calls and a deposit to sit down for a meal that was merely good. The cooking does not justify the friction. If they were easier to book I would go more and enjoy it more.

Genuinely superb. I had low expectations from the exterior and ate one of the best meals of the year. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The chef trained somewhere serious and every sauce showed it. The pork was extraordinary. Cheap for the quality and the room was half empty, which baffled me. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Exceptional food and genuinely lovely service. Our server noticed my partner was cold and moved us without being asked. The kitchen was excellent throughout, particularly the fish. The wine was interesting and fairly priced. A wonderful evening.

A well-judged menu and a kitchen that executes it. Nothing is overcomplicated and everything is properly seasoned, which sounds like a low bar and is not. The pork was excellent. The wine list is short and fairly priced. Very good indeed. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Good noodles, bad seating. The stools are backless & too high and after forty minutes I wanted to leave regardless of what was in front of me. What was in front of me was a decent bowl of dan dan noodles. I get takeout now and rate it higher. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

We wandered in without a booking on a wet Tuesday and had one of the best evenings of the year. The kitchen sent out plate after plate of properly seasoned, confident food. The lamb was outstanding. The staff were funny and generous and clearly enjoying themselves. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

We ate outstandingly well. Eight small plates between two, every one of them good & three of them exceptional. The whipped cod and the flatbread and the mushrooms were the standouts. The bill was a hundred dollars and it was worth every cent.

Excellent noodles and a broth that has real depth. You can tell when somebody has spent time on a stock and this is one of those. The pork was very good. The room is functional and cramped and I have never minded. Good value at seventeen dollars.

Three of us, three very different meals. Mine was excellent, my brother's was fine, and my mother's was sent back twice for being cold. She ended up eating a bowl of soup. The kitchen is capable and clearly not consistent, and that is a hard thing to book around.

Lunch was pleasant and slow. A ninety minute meal when I had an hour. The soup was excellent, properly seasoned and hot, and then the main took thirty-five minutes to follow it. I paid and left half of it and I will not make that mistake again on a work day.

The menu is enormous, which is usually a bad sign, and the food confirmed it. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Forty dishes across five cuisines and nothing done especially well. My noodles were acceptable, the dumplings were doughy, and the curry was sweet. Pick a lane.

Lunch here is a gamble. Some days the queue moves and the food is hot, some days you wait twenty-five minutes for a lukewarm box. Today was the second kind. The flavors are genuinely good when it works, which is why I keep going back and keep being annoyed.

Genuinely excellent pasta, made in house and cooked correctly. The carbonara had no cream in it, which should not be remarkable and is. The room is plain and the service is efficient. I have eaten here five times and will keep going.

Great value for the money and I want to be clear about that. Twelve dollars for a full plate of food. It is also true that the chicken was overcooked, the rice was dry, and the sauce came out of a jar. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. You get what you pay for and I would rather pay more.

I have been coming here for four years and something has changed. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. New owners, I think. The menu is shorter, the portions are smaller, and the cooking has lost whatever made it worth the trip. The pork that used to be the reason to come is now dry and sweet.

Half the menu was unavailable, the wine we ordered was corked & replaced with reluctance, and the main course took over an hour. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The pasta itself was decent. It is remarkable how little that matters when everything around it goes wrong.

The wings were pale & undercooked, the celery was limp, and the blue cheese dip had a skin on it. For a bar that puts wings at the top of the menu, that is a real problem. The beer was cold and correctly poured, which is the whole positive review. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

A confident kitchen that gets about two thirds of it right. Tonight the fish was excellent, the beef was overcooked, and the vegetables were beautifully done. That is better than most places manage and at this price I expected closer to all of it.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Had a very good starter and a very poor main, which is an odd way to eat. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The scallops were beautifully cooked. The beef that followed was tough enough that I stopped trying. Nobody asked why I had left most of it, which was its own small disappointment. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Very good Thai food with real heat, which is harder to find than it should be. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The papaya salad had genuine fire and the curry was properly balanced. The room is basic and the service is quick and a bit impersonal. The food more than makes up for it. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

I have eaten a lot of Thai food & this is the real thing. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Proper heat, proper balance, and a papaya salad that made my eyes water in the best way. The curry had a depth I have rarely found outside Thailand itself. Cheap and outstanding.

Every table around us got their food before ours despite arriving later. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. When I asked, our server said the kitchen works in batches. Our batch apparently never came. We ate ninety minutes after ordering & the food was visibly held. Poorly run from top to bottom.

Beautiful presentation and very little flavor. Every plate looked like it belonged in a magazine and tasted like it had been assembled rather than cooked. The dessert was the exception and was genuinely excellent. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The bill was a hundred and sixty dollars.

I have never had a bad ingredient here and I have rarely had a good dish. Everything is sourced carefully and cooked without much thought. The tomatoes in my salad were the best I have eaten this year and they were served cold from the fridge with no salt.

Very good food and one significant flaw: it is almost impossible to book. When I have got in I have eaten extremely well. The short rib is outstanding. If they took more reservations and fewer walk-ins this would be a regular for me.

The place has real character and a menu that has not changed in a decade, which is either charming or a warning. The fish and chips were heavy and the batter was pale. My father, who has been coming here for years, agreed it had slipped. He still tipped well.

The pizza base was excellent, properly blistered & light, and the toppings were mean. Four pieces of salami on a twelve inch pizza. When the fundamentals are that good it is maddening to see the thing let down by a decision somebody made about cost. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Everything about the experience was competent & nothing about it was memorable. The chicken was cooked correctly and tasted of nothing in particular. The vegetables were fine. I could not tell you a single thing about this meal a week from now.

The oil in the fryer needs changing and everyone in that kitchen must know it. The chips tasted of fish, the fish tasted of chicken, and everything tasted faintly burnt. Three of us ate and three of us left food. The mushy peas were fine.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

Made a reservation for eight thirty, seated at nine fifteen, ordered at nine forty, ate at ten twenty. The lamb was good. That is not enough. By the time it arrived we were too tired and too annoyed to enjoy it, and the bill came to two hundred dollars.

The best Indian food I have eaten in this city. The lamb bhuna has a depth that takes hours to build and the breads are made to order. The spicing is confident and nothing is toned down. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The room is simple and the cooking is exceptional. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Called ahead about a nut allergy and was assured it was fine. On arrival the server said the kitchen could not guarantee anything and suggested we order the salad. We left. If the answer is no, say no on the phone and save everyone the trip.

A menu full of promise & a kitchen that delivers none of it. Everything is described beautifully and arrives underseasoned. The lamb, the fish, the vegetables, all technically cooked and all tasting of nothing. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. My wife added salt to every single plate.

Very good food & an excellent bar. We had a drink before dinner that was as well made as anything in the city, and then ate very well. The beef was outstanding. The room is dark and comfortable and the whole evening worked.

Genuinely the worst brunch I have had in this city. The pancakes were raw in the middle, the bacon was flabby, & the orange juice was from a carton and warm. The queue outside was thirty people long. I stood in it for an hour. Never again.

Great food and a difficult table. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. We were seated in a corner with no light and could barely read the menu. The cooking was excellent regardless. The fish in particular was beautifully done. Ask for a different table and this becomes a five.

Nice place, ordinary food, and a staff that are clearly under-resourced. Two people running a full dining room. They did well and everything took a long time. The pasta was decent when it came. I would go back on a quieter night out of sympathy. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

There is a lovely restaurant hiding inside this one. The bread, the butter, the wine, the room, all excellent. The cooking of the actual dishes is where it falls down, and that is a hard thing to say because I wanted to love it and I did not.

Our table wobbled so badly that the wine spilled twice. We asked to move and were told the restaurant was full, which it visibly was not. Small thing, but it set the tone, and the tone did not improve when the appetizer arrived at the same time as the main.

Ordered the seafood platter for two. Half the mussels were closed, the calamari was rubber, & when I mentioned it the server told me that is just how it comes. We paid and left without dessert. There are six better places within walking distance.

Good bagels, indifferent fillings, and a queue that moves fast. The bagel itself is genuinely well made and the cream cheese is clearly the cheapest available. For six dollars that is a fair trade and I have stopped ordering the more expensive options.

Fresh, simple, and slightly boring. The kitchen does very little to the ingredients, which works when the ingredients are exceptional and does not when they are merely good. Tonight they were merely good. The bread and oil at the start were excellent.

A well-run front of house & a kitchen that is struggling. Our server noticed my glass was empty before I did and was genuinely lovely all evening. The food, though, was underseasoned across the board and two dishes were lukewarm. She deserves better.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. Good coffee, fresh pastries, and a twenty-five minute wait for a table at a cafe with eight seats. Once we sat, the eggs took another thirty. By the time we ate we had been there an hour for a breakfast that cost forty dollars between two of us.

The tea selection is excellent & the cakes are made on site, which you can taste. The savoury food is another matter. My quiche was soggy on the bottom and the salad beside it was undressed. Come for the afternoon, do not come for lunch.

The menu lives at [URL] & has not been updated in years. The chef came out to talk to us, which was a genuinely nice moment, and the food did not live up to the enthusiasm. His passion is obvious. The execution is not there yet. Underseasoned vegetables, a fish cooked two minutes too long, and a heavy dessert.

The seafood was good and the chips were excellent and the whole thing was thirty-eight dollars, which felt steep for a counter with plastic trays. The quality is there. The setting is not, and I think the pricing has been set by the former.

A restaurant with one very good idea and no follow-through. The opening dish was inventive and delicious. Everything after it was conventional. I would love to eat a whole meal cooked by whoever thought of the first course and I suspect they have left.

A friendly place with a kitchen that plays it very safe. Everything is competent and nothing surprises. The roast was tender, the gravy was thin, the vegetables were exactly as you would expect. Perfectly pleasant and I would not cross town for it.

Watched a cook handle raw chicken and then plate a salad without changing gloves. I said something. Nothing changed. We paid for the drinks we had ordered and left before the food arrived, and I would encourage anyone reading this to do the same. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Booked the private room for a work dinner and it turned out to be a corner of the main floor behind a screen. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Everyone could hear us and we could hear everything. The catering menu we had agreed was not what arrived. Genuinely embarrassing in front of clients.
