The fried rice was wet and the egg in it was in one solid sheet rather than through the dish. The pork was chewy. My friend's noodles were better but not by much. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. For a takeaway at these prices there are five places nearer that do it properly.

Exceptional value for cooking of this quality. Three courses for thirty-eight dollars, all of them better than food I have paid three times as much for. The fish was perfect. The room is simple and the focus is entirely on what is on the plate.

Exceptional food in a beautiful room at prices that are high & entirely fair. The fish was perfect, the vegetables were carefully cooked, and the wine pairing was thoughtful. Service was polished without being stiff. A genuinely special evening.

Went for a late dinner & the kitchen closed thirty minutes before the posted time. Nobody mentioned this when we sat down and ordered drinks. We were told after twenty minutes that we could have chips. That is the whole review, really.

Unremarkable in every direction. The room is fine, the service is fine, the chicken was fine. I have nothing to complain about & nothing to recommend. It is astonishing how forgettable a meal can be when nothing at all goes wrong.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. A decent Sunday roast with one weak component. The beef was pink and tender, the potatoes were crisp, and the Yorkshire pudding was clearly reheated and slightly rubbery. The gravy was excellent. Three out of four is not a bad afternoon. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The grilled meats were good and the salads were dressed with something so acidic it stripped the enamel off my teeth. My partner liked it. I spent the meal alternating between the two extremes. The flatbread in the middle was excellent and I ate most of it.

Lovely little place with four tables & a menu of six things. Everything we ate was carefully made, especially the aubergine, which was outstanding. The bread was bought in and you could tell. For the price and the care this is a real find.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Everything came out at once, which for a meal with three courses on the ticket is a problem. We ate what we could and let the rest cool. The food was good, the salmon especially. The kitchen clearly has no system for pacing a table and it undoes the cooking.

Loud enough that we gave up on conversation halfway through. The food was good, particularly the grilled octopus, and the cocktails were well made. I would come back alone at the bar and I would not bring anyone I actually wanted to talk to. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

We asked for the check three times over twenty-five minutes. I eventually went to the bar and paid there. Nobody seemed troubled by any of it. The meal beforehand was unremarkable, which at least made leaving easier than it might have been.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. I want to like this place. The chef is clearly talented & two of the six dishes were excellent. The other four were overworked, oversauced, and arrived cold from sitting on the pass. Consistency is the whole job at these prices and it is not there yet. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Outstanding Lebanese food and more of it than we could eat. The mezze were all excellent, particularly the muhammara and the labneh. The grilled meats were superb. The family who run it kept bringing more. We left full and happy and it cost very little.

This was a genuine surprise. I booked because it was near the cinema & ate an exceptional meal. The kitchen is doing careful, confident work and the menu is short and interesting. The pork was outstanding. We missed the film and did not mind. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Went twice in a month. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. First time excellent, second time the same dish was inedible from salt. I mentioned it & was told the chef seasons to his taste, which is a strange thing to say to somebody who cannot eat what they ordered. I am not going a third time. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

My colleague is coeliac and asked carefully about the gluten free options. The server was confident. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The kitchen was not, and she was unwell that evening. That is the entire review. I am not interested in the cooking of a place that handles that carelessly.

Really good pizza and a very good salad, which is unusual. The base was properly charred and the toppings were used sparingly and well. The room is loud and cheerful. It is the kind of place I would go every week if it were closer.

Fine Italian food in a room with too many mirrors. The pasta was fresh and the sauce was decent and the tiramisu was good. Nothing stood out and nothing was wrong. We paid ninety dollars for two and I would have been happier paying seventy.

Lovely staff, good food, & a room that is far too warm. We ate very well, particularly the fish, and left slightly uncomfortable. The kitchen is genuinely skilled and somebody needs to look at the ventilation. Everything else was excellent.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. Clean, quick, friendly and unremarkable. The kind of place that exists in every town and serves a real purpose. The chicken was fine, the rice was fine, the sauce was a bit sweet. Eleven dollars and out in twenty-five minutes.

Best Greek food I have eaten outside Greece. The lamb had been cooking all day, the salad was fresh and generous, and the bread came out of the oven while we waited. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The family who run it are wonderful. Cheap, warm and genuinely excellent. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The set menu here is excellent value and the cooking is genuinely accomplished. Four courses for forty-five dollars, all of them good and two of them memorable. The wine markup is steep. I would eat here monthly if I could get a table.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

It was fine. Genuinely, that is the review. The chicken was cooked properly, the salad was fresh, the bill was reasonable, and nothing about it made any impression on me at all. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. I have been twice and could not tell you what I ate the first time. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Efficient, clean, and entirely without charm. The food was good, particularly the noodles, and the whole transaction took thirty minutes from entering to leaving. That is either a compliment or a criticism depending on what you wanted from the evening.

A really enjoyable dinner. The kitchen is skilled & unfussy and everything arrived when it should. My duck was excellent and the vegetables were properly cooked. The only weak point was a dessert that was too sweet. The service was excellent.

Exceptional seafood pasta with real generosity in it, properly full of crab and prawns, and a sauce that was light and intense at once. The bread was excellent. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The room is plain and the cooking is exceptional and the prices are entirely fair.

Reliable lunch spot near the office. The salads are fresh, the soup rotates, and nothing has ever been bad. Nothing has ever been memorable either. I have eaten here maybe thirty times and could not describe a single dish to you in detail.

Ordered takeout & it was fine. The pad thai was sweet and the spring rolls were crisp. Nothing arrived cold, nothing was missing, and the bill was reasonable. There are four Thai places nearby and I could not tell you which one I ordered from last time.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers

The menu lives at [URL] & has not been updated in years. Best Korean fried chicken in the city, properly crisp with a sauce that has real depth. The banchan were generous and the stew we ordered alongside was excellent. Fast, cheap, warm and consistently superb. We order it most weekends.

The tasting menu is a lot of money for food that is merely good. Eleven courses, three of which I would call excellent, five fine, & three that did not work. At this price the ratio needs to be much better. The wine pairing was thoughtful and generous.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Went with a group of eight and the kitchen handled it well. Everything came out together and hot, which is genuinely difficult. The food was middle of the road, competent and unexciting across every dish. As a venue it worked. As a restaurant it was fine.

This is a genuinely great little restaurant. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Six tables, a chef who cooks everything herself, and a menu that changes daily depending on what she finds. Tonight was extraordinary. The fish was perfect and the vegetables beside it were better.

Two visits, two entirely different experiences. Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. Lunch was excellent and dinner was slow and mediocre. I suspect a different kitchen team. The menu is nearly identical. On the strength of the lunch I will go back at lunch and not at night.

Took visiting friends here and it showed the city off well. Good room, good service, & cooking that is confident without being showy. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The lamb and the fish were both excellent. The dessert menu could be more interesting. A very good evening overall.

Competent Thai food in a nice room at a fair price, and no dish I would order again. The curry was mild, the noodles were sweet, and the papaya salad had no fire in it at all. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. If you want the real thing there is a smaller place two streets away.

The kitchen is generous with chili and mean with everything else. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. My noodles were mostly sauce and heat with very little in them. The flavor was genuinely good and there were three small pieces of pork in a bowl that cost nineteen dollars.

Bad from the moment we walked in. The hostess sighed when we gave our name. We were seated next to the service station & spent ninety minutes listening to plates being stacked. The lamb was tough. The bill was wrong. Nothing about this worked.

Really enjoyed this. The kitchen is doing modern British food without being precious about it. The lamb was excellent & the vegetables were properly cooked. Service was relaxed and competent. Slightly expensive for a weeknight and worth it. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Outstanding cooking and a genuinely warm welcome. The chef came out at the end and talked to every table, which could be awkward and was not. The food was excellent throughout, particularly the fish. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Fair prices and a room I liked immediately.

The server spilled red wine across my wife's dress, which is forgivable, and then did not apologise or offer anything, which is not. We finished the meal in a strange silence. The food was somewhere between fine and forgettable and none of it mattered by then.

The tasting menu was three hours of genuine delight. Fourteen courses and not one of them was filler. The kitchen has a real point of view and the confidence to follow it. The wine pairing was thoughtful and generous. A serious restaurant and a joyful one.

Forty dollars for a brunch of two poached eggs, a slice of sourdough, & some rocket. The eggs were hard. The bread was cold. The coffee took twenty-five minutes. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The room is beautiful and the queue is long and I cannot work out why.

Booked, confirmed, arrived, & were told the kitchen had closed early due to staffing. At six thirty on a Saturday. No call, no email, no apology beyond a shrug. We were standing outside with two sets of visiting parents. Completely unacceptable. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Came in for a quick lunch & stayed two hours. The food kept being good enough to order more. The small plates are the strength here, particularly the mushrooms. The desserts were ordinary. The bill was more than I planned and I did not mind.

It is a lovely idea executed halfway. A daily changing menu written on a board, a tiny kitchen, an owner who clearly cares. The cooking is uneven. Tonight the soup was thin & the main was good. Last time it was the other way around.

The bread and butter alone would bring me back. The rest of the meal was very good too, particularly the fish, and the room is comfortable and well lit. Service was attentive early and then thinned out as it got busy. I would book early next time.

Every dish that reached our table was lukewarm. Not cold, which you could send back with a clear conscience, but lukewarm in a way that suggests it sat under a heat lamp while something else was finished. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The pasta had gone tacky. The sauce had separated.

Tiny portions dressed up as restraint. Three scallops on a smear of puree for twenty-eight dollars. I do not object to paying for skill but I do object to leaving a restaurant & stopping for a sandwich on the way home, which is exactly what we did. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

A really outstanding restaurant. Confident cooking, a short menu that changes often, and a room that is comfortable and unshowy. The pork belly was extraordinary. Our server was warm and knowledgeable. Prices are fair and I will be back within weeks.

Ordered three dishes and one of them, the aubergine, was outstanding. The other two were greasy. That ratio has held across four visits. I now order two portions of the aubergine and nothing else, which works well and is a strange way to eat dinner.

Genuinely the best sushi I have had in this country. The rice was at body temperature and seasoned exactly right, which almost nobody gets correct. The chef talked us through each piece without any pomp. Expensive, and I have already booked again.

Exceptional bagels & properly made coffee. The bagels are boiled and baked on site and the difference is obvious. The fillings are generous and well seasoned. There is always a queue and it moves fast. The best breakfast in the area for the money. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

They do one thing very well and the rest of the menu exists to pad it out. The roast chicken is excellent and worth ordering. The pasta, the salads and the fish are all clearly secondary and taste like it. I wish they would just be a chicken restaurant.

Reliable and uninspiring, which is exactly what I needed on a Tuesday and not what I want to write four stars about. The pasta was correctly cooked, the sauce was from a recipe I could make at home, and the bill was modest. I have been three times.

The vegetarian menu here is thoughtful and the rest is standard. As the only vegetarian in a group of five I ate better than everybody else, which almost never happens. The others had a fine time with unremarkable steaks and pasta.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

A really enjoyable evening. Good wine, good company, and a kitchen that sent out one excellent plate after another. My duck was pink and rested and the sauce was excellent. The dessert was a bit ordinary. Everything before it was worth the money. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Outstanding Ethiopian cooking, generous & deep and properly spiced. The injera was fresh and sour and the stews were all excellent. We ate with our hands and it took two hours and it was wonderful. The family running it were extremely kind. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Exactly what you expect from a neighbourhood Italian & no more. The pasta was properly cooked, the sauce was decent, the wine was cheap and fine. We go perhaps twice a year and will continue to, without ever getting excited about it. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Ate here twice in one week because it is near the office. First time, good. Second time, the same dish arrived undercooked and lukewarm. I do not think they are careless so much as understaffed at lunch. The prices are fair and the coffee is excellent.

Very good bread, very good coffee, and sandwiches that cost more than they should. Fourteen dollars for cheese and pickle on sourdough. The sourdough is excellent. I keep buying them and I keep thinking about the price on the walk back.

Ordered the special and the regular menu dish and both landed in the same middling place. The fish was cooked adequately, the sauce was thin, and the vegetables were good. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Nothing was wrong with any of it. The bill for two came to seventy dollars, which felt like ten too many. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

I do not enjoy writing this because the staff were kind. But the food was bad. The soup was watery, the bread was dense, and the main was a portion of stew that had clearly been reheated more than once. Kindness does not make a meal edible.

An exceptional evening. The room is beautiful, the wine list is full of interesting things, and the kitchen is doing careful and confident cooking. Every plate was excellent and the lamb was outstanding. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Expensive, and I will be saving up to go back.

A perfect little wine bar. The list is short, interesting and honestly priced, and the food is far better than it needs to be. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The cheese selection is excellent and the small hot plates are genuinely good. The staff know their list properly.

Perfectly decent food in a room with no atmosphere at all. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Bright lights, bare tables, and a television on in the corner. The curry was well spiced and I ate it quickly and left. For takeaway I would rate this higher than I have.

Decent food at a fair price in a room that badly needs cleaning. Sticky menus and a table that had not been properly wiped. I know that sounds fussy and it genuinely affects how you eat. The chicken was good. I could not stop looking at the floor.

Genuinely dangerous. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. My chicken skewer was raw in the centre and I only noticed on the third bite. I stopped eating and told the manager, who offered to remake it. I did not want it remade, I wanted to leave, and I am writing this partly so others check.

It does exactly one thing and does it adequately. Roast chicken, chips, and a green salad. The chicken was slightly dry and the chips were excellent. There is no menu to speak of and no decision to make, which is restful. I have been three times.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

I was sceptical about the queue and then I ate the sandwich. Genuinely very good bread, generous filling, and a proper amount of acidity to cut through it. Forty minutes is a long time to wait and I would do it again on a day off.

The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Outstanding. The tasting menu was inventive without ever losing sight of flavor, which is the trap most places fall into. Every course was properly seasoned and every one had a point. The service was excellent and the room is calm. A serious restaurant.

The concept is charming and the food is average. A tiny place, one cook, a menu of four things. Everything is made with care and none of it is especially good. I admire the enterprise and I would not go out of my way for the food.

The service was excellent, attentive without hovering, and the food was middling. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. My duck was fine, my partner's fish was overcooked, and the shared sides were both underseasoned. We had a nice evening, which was not really the restaurant's doing.

A perfectly good meal in a restaurant that thinks it is better than it is. The service is formal to the point of stiffness & the food does not justify it. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. My duck was well cooked. The whole thing felt like a performance of a nicer restaurant.

Good sauces, poor proteins. Whoever is making the sauces in this kitchen is skilled and whoever is cooking the meat is not. My chicken was dry and sat in something genuinely excellent. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. It is an odd combination and it happened twice across our table. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The pizza is good and the wait is long and the room is uncomfortable. Those three things have been true every time. I keep going because the pizza is good, and I have started ordering it for collection, which resolves two of the three problems.

A perfect long lunch. Good light, comfortable chairs, a kitchen that is in no hurry & neither were we. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Everything we ate was excellent, particularly the fish and the bread. Three hours, two bottles, and a bill that was very fair for the afternoon.

A perfectly serviceable lunch that took twice as long as it should have. The soup was good, the sandwich was fine, and the gap between them was twenty-five minutes. If you have an hour, go. If you have forty minutes, do not.

The service was so slow that we had time to read the entire wine list twice. The wine, when it came, was excellent. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The food, when it came much later, was fine. If you have three hours & no particular plans this is a pleasant enough way to spend them.

The kitchen is ambitious and about seventy percent successful. Tonight the scallops were beautiful, the beef was overcooked, and the dessert was one of the better things I have eaten this year. It is a young restaurant and I expect it to get better.

This is the best pizza in the city and I will argue about it. The base has a long ferment and comes out light and blistered and properly chewy. The tomato is excellent and they use it sparingly. Loud, cheap, fast, and absolutely superb. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Very good Korean fried chicken, properly crisp & well sauced. The banchan were generous and varied. The beer selection is limited and the service is fast to the point of abrupt. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The chicken is the reason to come and it delivers every time.

Very good sushi at prices that are steep and roughly fair. The fish is clearly high quality and the rice was well seasoned, though slightly warmer than I like. The chef was generous with explanations. A genuinely good meal and an expensive one.

I had a good evening here & I would not credit the food for it. The company was excellent, the wine was reasonable, and the meal itself was a series of competent, unremarkable plates. The kitchen is not the reason to come and it is not a reason to avoid it.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

Slow, expensive, and mostly pleasant. Our server was charming and the room is beautiful and the food took so long that we missed the last train. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The fish was good. I would need a free evening and a forgiving mood to do this again.

Mixed evening. The appetizers were excellent, the mains were ordinary, and the dessert was excellent again. Whoever is working the cold and pastry sections is better than whoever is on the grill. The wine was well chosen and reasonably marked up.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

Very good Greek food, generous & well seasoned. The lamb was excellent and the salad was fresh and properly dressed. The bread was clearly bought in, which is a small thing. The family who run it are lovely and the prices are fair. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Ordered delivery and the driver arrived with the wrong bag. The restaurant refused to resend, telling me it was the platform's problem. The platform told me it was the restaurant's. I ate somebody else's salad. Nobody has refunded me and nobody intends to.

Consistently good over five visits, which matters more to me than one spectacular meal. The pasta is always properly cooked & the specials are always worth asking about. The wine list is short and fairly priced. The room gets very hot in summer.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. Lovely staff, clean room, decent coffee, and a kitchen that clearly reheats. My shakshuka arrived with a skin across the top and a cold centre. The bread was good and fresh. The ingredients are there and something in the process is going badly wrong.

Chaotic service, a kitchen that is clearly underwater, and a room that badly needs cleaning. The one bright spot was the bartender, who was doing three jobs at once and still managed to be gracious. Everything that came out of the kitchen was a disappointment.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Very good Gujarati thali, generous and varied, with several standout dishes. The dal was excellent. It arrives all at once and keeps coming and you will not leave hungry. The room is functional and the value is remarkable for what you get.

Lunch took an hour longer than it should have because the kitchen forgot one of our orders. When it came it was good. The rest of us had finished. My colleague ate alone while we drank coffee. Nobody offered anything for the trouble and nobody apologised.

The dumplings were doughy and the filling was mostly cabbage. The chili oil was the only thing on the table with any flavor. My niece, who eats everything, would not finish hers. For a place with a queue out the door this was a real letdown.

Excellent Vietnamese food with real care taken over the herbs and pickles, which are usually an afterthought. The banh mi is very good and the pho is better. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The room is basic and the service is quick. Cheap, generous and consistently good.

Somebody in the kitchen has confused salt with seasoning. Every single dish, from the appetizer through the main, tasted of nothing but salt. My father, who puts salt on everything, could not finish his. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The dessert was sweet enough to be a relief.

It is fine. That is the honest summary. The burger was cooked as asked, the bun held together, the chips were adequate. Nothing was wrong and nothing was good, and for twenty-four dollars I want at least one of those two things to be untrue. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Best pierogi outside my grandmother's kitchen. Clearly handmade, properly filled, & served with onions cooked slowly and correctly. The soup was excellent too. Two people run the whole place and it takes a while and I did not care at all.

A middling experience saved by a genuinely excellent dessert. The main courses were dull, the wine was overpriced, and then a chocolate tart arrived that was worth the whole evening. We ordered a second one. That is the review.

The chef has ideas and the kitchen cannot land them. A dish described as smoked, cured and charred arrived tasting faintly of all three and strongly of nothing. The ambition is genuine. The result was a plate of expensive confusion that I did not finish. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

The bathroom had no soap, no paper, & a lock that did not work. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. I mentioned it to the staff and it was still the same an hour later. Whatever standards are being kept out of sight are presumably no better. The food tasted fine and I stopped caring.

Very good Ethiopian food & a genuinely warm welcome. The injera was fresh and the stews were varied and well spiced. The doro wat was outstanding. It takes a long time, which is the nature of the food, and you should plan for a slow evening.

Excellent barbecue with a genuine smoke ring and proper bark on the brisket. The sides are where it slips, particularly the beans, which were too sweet. Everything from the smoker was very good and I would happily eat here once a month.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

The smell hit us before we sat down & we should have trusted it. Old oil, and everything fried in it tasted the same. The batter on the fish, the onion rings, the chips, all carrying that same stale note. We left most of it and paid in full. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Very good Lebanese food and a huge amount of it. We over-ordered and took half of it home. The mezze were excellent, particularly the muhammara, and the grilled meats were very good. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. Service is brisk and the prices are more than fair.

A genuinely great restaurant hiding on a quiet street. The cooking is skilled and generous, the room is comfortable, and the staff are warm. My duck was perfect and the sauce was extraordinary. I have recommended it to everyone I know.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

The dessert menu is excellent and I would come back for the tart alone. Getting to it required sitting through a main course of overcooked chicken and a side of potatoes that had been kept warm too long. Skip to dessert if they will let you.

Outstanding little restaurant. Six tables, a short menu, and cooking that is careful and confident. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The fish was perfect and the vegetables were exceptional. The wine list is small and well chosen. Book well ahead because it deserves to be full. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

Genuinely outstanding vegetarian cooking. I am not vegetarian & I did not miss anything. The roasted cauliflower with tahini was one of the best dishes of my year. Everything was properly seasoned and interesting. Book well ahead, it is always full.

The oysters were excellent & everything cooked was poor. Whatever this kitchen does with heat is going wrong, because the same quality of seafood that shines raw came out dry and tough when grilled. Stick to the raw bar and you will do well here.

Exceptional cooking & genuinely lovely people. The menu is short and changes constantly and everything on it is properly made. Tonight the fish was perfect and the vegetables were as good. The wine is fairly priced and well chosen. A real find.

The meal was better than the service and the service was better than the booking process. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. An ascending scale. By the time the food arrived I had mostly forgotten the earlier annoyances, which is the best thing I can say. The duck was good.

Excellent brunch, very good coffee, and a wait that is entirely predictable at weekends. The eggs were properly cooked and the bread was good. Go early or go on a weekday. The kitchen is consistent and I have never had a bad plate here.

Exceptional seafood shack with no pretensions whatsoever. Plastic chairs, paper plates, & crab as fresh as any I have eaten. The chips were excellent. It costs very little and the quality is extraordinary. We went twice in one weekend.

We came for my mother's seventieth and they made the whole evening. A quiet corner table, a candle on the dessert without being asked, and food that had everyone at the table going quiet. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The lamb was exceptional. I cannot fault a single thing.

The ramen was excellent. Deep broth, proper bite to the noodles, and an egg cooked exactly right. The queue was thirty minutes, which is the only mark against it. On a weekday afternoon when you can walk in this would be five stars without question.

The vegetables in my stir fry were raw in the middle & the sauce had the sticky sweetness of something out of a jar. My colleague's noodles were swimming in oil. We work nearby and were looking for a regular lunch spot. The search continues.

The dining room smelled of bleach and the table was still wet when we sat down. That is better than the alternative, I suppose, but it did not put anyone in the mood to eat. The food was slow and heavy. We were done in forty minutes and glad of it.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

The tasting menu was excellent & long. Three hours and fourteen courses, which is more than I wanted by the end. Individually almost everything was very good and several were outstanding. The pacing is the only thing I would change.

Excellent coffee and genuinely good food, which is an unusual combination. The eggs were properly cooked and the bread was made in house. It is small and busy and you will probably wait. Worth it on a morning when you are not in a hurry.

The best Korean fried chicken I have eaten. Properly crisp, still juicy underneath, and the sauce has real depth rather than just sugar. The banchan were generous and varied. Service is fast and friendly and the prices are very fair.

This is a perfectly decent restaurant that has convinced itself it is a great one, and the prices reflect the belief rather than the cooking. My main was competent. The bill was not. There are three better places within five minutes at two thirds the cost.

One of my favourite places for a quiet dinner. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Low lighting, good wine, & a kitchen that does simple things extremely well. The roast chicken for two is excellent and worth the wait. The starters are ordinary and I order them anyway.

Generous, cheap and rough around the edges. The curry was full of flavor and quite oily. The rice was plentiful. The room is bright and loud and the tables are plastic. For fourteen dollars I have no real complaints and no enthusiasm either.

The burger is excellent & I have eaten a lot of burgers. Properly seasoned, correctly cooked, and a bun that holds. The chips were merely fine. The room is loud and fun and the beer is well kept. A genuinely good version of a simple thing.

Took a client here and it did exactly what I needed. Quiet enough to talk, food good enough to impress, and service that was present without hovering. My fish was excellent. The bill was substantial and entirely justified by the evening.

Very good Peruvian food, which is hard to find here. The ceviche was excellent, properly acidic and fresh, and the grilled meats were very good. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The room is small and gets loud. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable about the menu.

I have been three times & had one good meal, one average and one poor. Tonight was poor. The pork was dry and the apple sauce was from a jar. The pub itself is warm and the beer is well kept. I will keep coming for the beer.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

Very good meal with one flat note. The braised short rib was outstanding, properly rich and falling apart, and the potatoes beside it were underseasoned. Everything else, from the bread to the wine to the service, was excellent. I have already booked again. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

Came for a birthday and they looked after us properly. The kitchen sent out an extra plate we had not ordered, the server remembered which of us was celebrating, and the food was very good throughout. The dessert was slightly sweet for me and that is all.

Nice staff, dated room, decent food. The prawns were good, the rice was slightly wet, & the service was warm throughout. It has been here twenty years and looks it. I would come back with my parents and not with friends.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Excellent value and genuinely good cooking. Fifteen dollars for a plate of grilled meat, rice and salad, all of it well made. The room is spartan and the service is fast. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. I eat here most weeks and have never had a bad plate.

Sticky menus, a bathroom I regretted visiting, & a kitchen that sent out fries so old they had gone soft. The burger underneath was grey through the middle. I want to be fair but there is nothing here to be fair about. It was cheap and it was still bad.

Friendly, fast, and forgettable. The burrito was enormous and mostly rice. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The salsa had no heat. I ate it in the car in ten minutes and could not tell you anything about it now except that it filled a gap. Cheap, and you can taste where the money was saved.

Exceptional from the moment we sat down. The bread was warm, the wine was interesting and fairly priced, and the kitchen sent out one precise plate after another. The fish was flawless and the vegetables beside it were just as good. Our server was warm and genuinely knowledgeable.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The pizza was good, the base was properly blistered, & the service was so slow we had time to finish a bottle before it arrived. Small place, one oven, enormous queues. If you are not in a hurry it is a genuinely nice evening.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Great value set lunch & a genuinely skilled kitchen. Two courses for nineteen dollars and both were better than they had any right to be. The soup was excellent. The dining room is plain and the service is quick and friendly.

Overcooked, oversauced, and overpriced. Three things I will forgive individually and not in combination. The duck was grey through, the cherry sauce was jam, and the bill for two was a hundred and forty dollars. The bread and butter were genuinely excellent. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

One of the better lunches I have had near the office. The soup was excellent and hot and the sandwich was well made on good bread. It took a bit longer than I had, which is my problem rather than theirs. I have been back three times since.

The coffee is excellent & the food is an afterthought. I come here three mornings a week for the coffee and have eaten the food perhaps five times. The pastries are bought in and taste like it. The people behind the counter are the best thing about it.

The meal was fine & the follow-up was not. I emailed about a charge on the bill and heard nothing for three weeks, then received a reply that did not address the question. The food was decent, the room is nice, and I have stopped trying.

Ordered for a group and the restaurant handled it smoothly. The food arrived hot and together and was uniformly acceptable. Nobody complained and nobody raved. For feeding twelve people on a weeknight that is a genuine success and a dull review.

Cheap lunch, decent quality, no atmosphere whatsoever. I eat here perhaps once a fortnight and have never had a bad meal or a good one. The soup rotates daily and is reliably fine. It is the definition of a three star restaurant and I mean that neutrally.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Twenty-two dollars for a bowl of noodles I could have made better at home. The broth was thin & the pork was dry, though the pickled vegetables on the side were excellent. There is a queue every evening and I genuinely do not understand what I am missing.

An exceptional restaurant that deserves far more attention than it gets. Careful, precise cooking, a short and interesting menu, and prices that are honest. The fish was perfect. The room was half full on a Friday, which I found genuinely baffling.

Whoever designed this dining room hates conversation. Bare walls, bare floor, hard ceiling, tables a foot apart. Add a full house & it is genuinely painful. The food is beside the point, though for the record the risotto was stodgy and underseasoned.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Reserved a table for six for my mother's birthday. They sat us at two separate tables on opposite sides of the room and would not move anyone. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The staff treated the whole thing as our problem. The food was fine. The evening was ruined before it started.

A warm, well-run restaurant with a kitchen that cares. Our server noticed my glass was empty before I did. The lamb was excellent and my partner's fish was very good. The dessert menu is short and dull, which is a small complaint in a good evening. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Really good Nigerian food and a very warm welcome. The jollof was excellent and the stew was properly deep. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The portions are enormous. The room is simple and the service is unhurried. I have been three times and taken somebody different each time.

The menu changes daily which I admire and the execution varies just as much. Last month I had one of the best meals of the year here. Tonight the fish was undercooked and the sauce had split. Same restaurant, same price, entirely different experience.

Genuinely the best thing to happen to this street. Careful cooking, honest prices, a warm room & staff who clearly enjoy being there. The lamb was excellent and the bread was made that day. We have been four times in two months.

I would describe this as expensive comfort food done adequately. The mac and cheese was gluey, the fried chicken was good, and the greens were cooked to death. It is the sort of menu that is hard to get wrong and they managed it in two places out of three.

The prices have gone up and the portions have come down, which I could live with if the quality had held. It has not. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The brisket is drier than it was and the sides are smaller. Still a nice place to sit on a Sunday, still not what it used to be. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

A lovely surprise. I booked because it was nearby and ate one of the better meals I have had this year. The kitchen is skilled and the menu is interesting without being difficult. The dessert was the only ordinary thing. Very good service. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Really good pizza with a properly fermented base. You can taste the difference. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The toppings are simple & well chosen. The room is loud and the tables are small and the whole thing costs twenty dollars a head. I go every few weeks. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Exceptional noodles and a broth I would drink on its own. The pork is braised properly and the egg is perfect every time. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The room is cramped and functional and nobody comes here for the room. Seventeen dollars and consistently the best bowl nearby.

Excellent value for a set lunch. Three courses for twenty-four dollars and every one of them properly cooked. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The soup was the highlight. It is a short menu and it changes weekly and I have been four times without repeating a dish.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Waited three weeks for this booking and left underwhelmed. Technically accomplished food with no warmth in it. Every plate was precise and cold, in both senses. The sommelier was excellent and the wine was the best part of the evening by a distance.

The best burger I have eaten. Properly seasoned, cooked to a genuine medium, and a bun that held together to the last bite. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The chips were excellent too. The room is loud and cheerful and the beer is cold. Twenty dollars and I have been back four times.

The set lunch is excellent value and the a la carte is not. Twenty-two dollars for three courses at midday, sixty for roughly the same food at night. The cooking is the same and it is decent. Come at lunch and you will rate this place higher.

A well-meaning kitchen that overreaches. Simple dishes here are very good & the complicated ones fall apart. My friend had a plate of grilled fish with lemon that was perfect. I had something with six components and it tasted muddled.

Good pizza, bad everything else. We should have ordered two pizzas. Instead we got a salad that was mostly stalk & a plate of arancini that were cold in the middle. The pizza was genuinely very good and I have marked this down for the things around it.

A hostess who could not find our booking, a server who could not answer a question about the menu, & a kitchen that sent a cold plate. Three separate failures in one meal. The room is lovely and somebody has spent money on it. Nobody has spent it on staff.

Very good Oaxacan food and a genuinely knowledgeable staff who explained the moles properly. The negro was excellent. The tortillas are made in house and you can taste it. The room is small and the queue is long and it moves at a reasonable pace.

A genuinely good restaurant that is let down by the wine list, which is short and heavily marked up. The food was excellent, particularly the pork, and the service was warm. We drank beer instead and had a very good evening anyway.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Charged a cake-cutting fee of fifteen dollars that was mentioned nowhere & applied without warning. I would have paid it without complaint if asked. Finding it on the bill soured the end of an evening in which the food had already been fairly average.

This place is a gift. Cheap, generous, delicious food cooked by people who obviously care. The pho broth has real depth and the herbs come out in handfuls. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Sixteen dollars for a bowl that is better than places charging twice as much. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Came for brunch on a whim & it was excellent. The eggs were properly cooked, the sourdough was good, and the coffee was among the best I have had locally. The queue moved fast. I have already brought two other people since.

A perfect meal. Nothing overreached, nothing was underseasoned, and everything arrived exactly when it should have. The lamb was extraordinary and the bread was excellent. The service was warm and invisible in the way the best service is.

Great produce, plain cooking. The vegetables are clearly from a good supplier & are mostly served roasted with olive oil and salt. That works about half the time. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The tomatoes were extraordinary and the squash was dull. The bread was excellent.

Extraordinary bread and a kitchen that lives up to it. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The loaves are baked on site and are the best in the city. The lunch menu is short and everything on it is properly considered. The soup was excellent. I come here at least twice a week.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. A cafe that is much better at coffee than food, which is common and still slightly annoying at these prices. The flat white was excellent. The toastie was dry. I paid nineteen dollars for both and I will pay six for the coffee next time.

Went for a work lunch and it did the job without distinguishing itself. Quiet enough to talk, quick enough to get back, and the food was acceptable. My salmon was fine. Three of us ate for sixty dollars and nobody mentioned the food afterwards.

Extraordinary dumplings. Skins thin enough to see through, filling properly seasoned, and a chili oil that I have since tried and failed to replicate at home. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The queue is long and moves fast and is entirely worth it. Twelve dollars for eight pieces. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

A really good meal with a slightly high bill. Everything we ate was well made, particularly the beef and the aubergine. Two hundred dollars for two with a bottle of wine felt like the top of what it was worth. I would come back for an occasion.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

Great seafood, simply done. Grilled fish with lemon, good bread, a fresh salad. There is nothing complicated here and everything is properly executed. The prices are high and the produce justifies it. The terrace in summer is lovely.

My partner's meal arrived twenty-five minutes after mine. I offered to wait, the server insisted I eat, and then nobody checked on us for the entire gap. We had been looking forward to this for weeks and left feeling flat. The cooking itself was unremarkable. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Exceptional & completely unpretentious. A short menu of things the kitchen does well, cooked properly, served warmly, at honest prices. The fish was perfect and the bread was excellent. This is exactly the restaurant I want in my neighbourhood.

This place does one thing and does it perfectly. Roast chicken, chips, green salad, garlic sauce. That is the whole menu. The chicken is brined and the skin is crisp and the chips are cooked in the fat. Thirty dollars for two and I go constantly.

I have had better and I have had much worse. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The tacos were fine, the fillings were generous, the tortillas were a little dry. My friend from Mexico City was polite about it. We ate, we paid twenty dollars each, and we went somewhere else for a drink.

Cannot understand the reviews. The barbecue was dry, the sauce was sugary, & the cornbread crumbled into dust. The brisket had no bark and no smoke ring. I have eaten at a lot of places doing this and this is the weakest by a considerable distance. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Went with high hopes after a friend's recommendation and I am now questioning the friendship. The curry was oily and one-note, the rice was cold, and the naan had the texture of cardboard. My friend insists they have an off night sometimes. This was mine.

Ninety minutes between the appetizer and the main. Ninety. We asked twice and were told it was coming. When it arrived the kitchen had clearly rushed it, because my chicken was pink at the bone and my wife's rice was crunchy. We sent both back and left. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

A really good evening. The kitchen is skilled, the wine list is interesting, & our server was one of the best I have had in years. The food was very good throughout with one dish, the scallops, standing out. The dessert was fine. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Ordered four dishes and liked two. The fried chicken was excellent and the slaw was good. The mac and cheese was gluey and the greens were oversalted. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. My partner had the opposite opinion on two of the four, which tells you it is a matter of taste.

The dining room is beautiful and the food is ordinary and the service is genuinely excellent. Three different standards in one restaurant. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. If you are there for an occasion it works. If you are there to eat well you would do better elsewhere for less.

Long wait, decent food, fair price. All three of those are true & I am not sure how to weigh them. The noodles were good. Fifty minutes is a long time to stand outside for good noodles when adequate noodles are available immediately three doors down.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The room is beautiful and the food lives up to it, which is rarer than it should be. My lamb was excellent and the vegetables that came with it were properly cooked. Our server was a little stiff. A genuinely lovely place for an occasion.

The only hot thing on the table was the complaint I made at the end. Appetizers cold, mains cold, plates cold. Somebody has switched off a warmer somewhere & nobody has noticed for what I suspect is a long time. The flavors underneath were fine.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

An hour after we arrived we still had no food & no explanation, so we asked for the bill for the drinks and left. Nobody tried to stop us or asked what was wrong. On the way out I saw three tables in the same position. Something is badly broken here. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

I do not know who is running this kitchen but the seasoning has gone badly wrong. The soup was so salty it was genuinely difficult to finish a spoonful, and the braised beef underneath it was worse. We left most of the meal on the plate and nobody asked why.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Came for the famous fried chicken and got something pale and soggy that had clearly been sitting. The sides were better but the sides are not why anyone comes. Two people at the next table sent theirs back. Ours went in the bin at home.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

Ate here on a Tuesday when nothing else nearby was open and it was better than I expected. The stew was well made, the bread was fresh, the room was empty and slightly sad. I would not seek it out and I was glad it existed.

Exceptional tasting menu that was inventive and, crucially, delicious throughout. Fourteen courses over three hours with no filler at all. The wine pairing was generous & well judged. The service was precise and warm. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. A genuinely great restaurant. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Genuinely exceptional. I have been three times in a month, which tells you everything. The cooking is confident and generous, the room is lovely, and the prices are honest. The lamb is extraordinary and the bread is excellent. Cannot fault it.

The server upsold us on a bottle of wine, then never came back to pour it, & we drank most of the meal out of glasses we filled ourselves. The food came out in a random order. The one dish I actually wanted, the special, was gone by the time we ordered.

Excellent cocktails, a bartender who clearly knows what he is doing, and a kitchen that sent out three cold plates in a row. We ate at the bar and watched our food sit on the pass for several minutes before anyone picked it up. That is a management problem.

Our server was new and clearly nervous and got two things wrong, which is entirely forgivable. The kitchen sending out a raw-centred burger is less so. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. They replaced it quickly and took it off the bill. The rest of the meal was decent and the evening was fine.

Booked for a birthday, mentioned it, and they brought out a candle without being asked, which was a nice touch. The food did not match the gesture. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Two of the four mains came out cold and the vegetables were mushy. The staff were lovely throughout.

Genuinely good cooking at a fair price in a room with no atmosphere at all. Bright lights & hard chairs. The food was excellent, particularly the grilled fish. I now order takeaway, which loses nothing, and I rate the food five and the room two.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

A genuinely great restaurant. The kitchen is doing personal, precise cooking and the front of house is warm and completely on top of things. My fish was flawless and the dessert was extraordinary. Not cheap and I would spend it again tomorrow.

Very good food in a beautiful room at prices that are high and not unreasonable. The fish was excellent and the vegetables were carefully cooked. Service was polished. I would come back for a celebration and not for a Tuesday. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Everything about this was right. The bread arrived warm, the wine was interesting & fairly priced, the fish was cooked exactly as it should be, and the service was warm and completely unfussy. A genuinely lovely restaurant and we will be back soon.

An institution that is trading on it. The dining room is beautiful & the waiters have been here for decades and the food has not moved since the nineties. My sole was competently cooked and swimming in butter. Worth seeing once and not worth eating twice.

Lovely food and a slightly awkward room. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The tables by the kitchen door are worth avoiding and we were at one of them. The cooking was excellent regardless, particularly the pork, and the staff were warm. I would book and ask for a table at the front.

Somebody needs to taste the food before it leaves the kitchen. The pork belly was pure fat with no crackling, the greens beside it were boiled to grey, and the jus was cold. This is not a matter of taste, it is a matter of basic quality control. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Excellent for a group. We were ten & they handled it without a fuss, splitting the bill and keeping everything hot. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The food was good across the board and the pork in particular was excellent. Booking for a large group is easy, which is rare.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. Best brunch I have had in a long time. The eggs were perfect, the bacon was crisp, the sourdough was excellent, and the coffee was properly made. There was no queue on a Wednesday. I have been three times in a month and taken somebody different each time.

Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Our server disappeared entirely after taking the order. Food arrived via a runner, drinks never arrived at all, & we paid at the counter on the way out. There is a staffing problem here and the customers are absorbing all of it. The pasta was overcooked. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

A really good local restaurant that I am glad exists. The menu is short, the cooking is careful, & the prices are honest. Tonight the pork was excellent. The desserts are the weak point and I always order one anyway. Four stars comfortably. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

Everything about this worked. The room is beautiful without being precious, the wine list is interesting & fairly priced, and the kitchen is doing careful, confident work. My fish was perfectly cooked. We stayed three hours and did not want to leave.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

The mushroom risotto had the texture of wallpaper paste and the flavor of the stock cube it was clearly built on. I left most of it. When the server cleared the plate she did not ask, which I suppose means it happens a lot. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Forget this one and go elsewhere.

The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Paid twenty-six dollars for a salad that was mostly leaves and a dressing that was mostly sugar. The chicken on top was dry and clearly cooked hours earlier. I work nearby and was hoping for a regular spot. This will not be it at any price, let alone that one.

The food was good and the room was cold and I could not get past it. We ate in coats. The staff acknowledged the heating was broken and were apologetic. The risotto was well made and I would come back in summer to find out if I actually like this place.

Excellent value and generous cooking. The set menu at lunch is twenty-two dollars for three courses and every one was properly made. The soup was very good. The dining room is plain and the staff are efficient and kind.

The tortillas were dry & cracked when folded, which is a fundamental problem for a taqueria. The fillings were heavily salted to compensate. My friend, who is from Oaxaca, ate one and spent the rest of the meal describing what it should have tasted like.

Good beer, decent chips, and a burger that was grey through the middle when I had asked for medium. The staff were apologetic and quick to offer a replacement, which I declined because I did not want to eat alone. Two stars, and the pub itself is lovely.

Outstanding cooking from a very small kitchen. One chef, one assistant, a menu of six dishes that changes with what they can get. Tonight the fish was perfect & the vegetable dish alongside it was extraordinary. Book two weeks out, it is worth it.

The staff were arguing loudly in the kitchen & we could hear all of it from our table. The food that emerged from that kitchen was, unsurprisingly, poorly executed. Cold plates, a missing side, and a steak cooked to a temperature nobody requested.

Pleasant enough lunch with one significant problem: the entire meal took ninety minutes & I had to leave before dessert. The soup was excellent. The sandwich that followed it forty minutes later was cold in the middle. I will not be coming back on a work day.

Outstanding value and outstanding cooking. The set lunch is twenty dollars for three courses from a kitchen that clearly has serious training. The soup was perfect and the main was excellent. The room is plain and I could not care less.

Small plates that are genuinely small and mostly good. Six between two of us came to ninety dollars and we were not full. The octopus was excellent, the bread was excellent, and the rest was fine. It is a lot of money for a meal you have to finish elsewhere. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

I have eaten here eleven times in two years & it has never once slipped. The pasta is made every morning and you can taste it. The carbonara is the best in the city. The owner remembers what you drank last time. A genuinely special local restaurant.

Sticky floors, a cracked plate, and a glass with lipstick on the rim that was not mine. I stopped looking closely after that. The food was standard and cheap, and in a place this grubby cheap is not enough. There are better options two streets over.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. A really wonderful evening. The kitchen is confident, the room is lively without being loud, and the staff are genuinely enjoying themselves. Every dish was excellent and the pork in particular was outstanding. The bill was very fair for what we ate.

A lot of noise about local sourcing and not much flavor on the plate. The vegetables were beautiful and served nearly raw with no seasoning. The fish was good. I believe everything they say about where the food comes from and I wish they would cook it.

Decent, honest cooking that has not changed in a decade & does not need to. The steak pie is good, the chips are good, the peas come from a freezer. It is a pub and it behaves like one and the prices are fair. I have no complaints and no strong feelings.

The thali was generous and several of the small dishes were excellent, particularly the dal. Two of them were oily and one was cold. For fifteen dollars I am not going to complain loudly, and I would order it again while hoping for a better night.

The dessert was excellent, the wine was well chosen, and the two courses before them were forgettable. This is a bar with a kitchen attached rather than a restaurant, and if you approach it that way you will have a better evening than we did.

Excellent little place doing one thing properly. Handmade noodles, three sauces, nothing else. The dan dan noodles were outstanding. You sit at a counter and eat quickly and it costs twelve dollars. I go most weeks and never get tired of it.

Paid extra for the tasting menu and got seven small plates of the same idea repeated. Everything was sweet, everything was topped with the same herb, and by the fourth course I was bored. The kitchen clearly has ambition and no editor. Two hours I would like back. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Ordered takeout & the packaging was excellent, everything sealed and still hot. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Then I opened it. The noodles had absorbed all the sauce and turned into a solid mass, and the vegetables were soft. Good ingredients treated carelessly at the last step.

The shawarma was dry and the garlic sauce had separated into oil and solids. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The pickles were good. That is the entire positive content of this review. For eighteen dollars I expect the main component of the dish to be edible without effort.

A neighbourhood place doing its best with a small kitchen. The stew was hearty and slightly burnt at the bottom, which you could taste. The bread was excellent. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. I want to support it and I would not travel for it, and the prices are honest.

The bao were pillowy and the filling was excellent. Everything else we ordered was greasy. The fried chicken was heavy, the noodles were swimming, and by the end of the meal my mouth felt coated. Order two bao and leave. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. That is my honest advice.

Good, cheap, and a bit grim. The room has not been decorated since the eighties and the lighting is unforgiving. The food is genuinely well cooked, particularly the grilled meats, and it costs half what it would two streets away. I take the trade. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. The tempura was heavy and oily, the dipping sauce was cold, and the miso came out at the end of the meal. Whatever is happening in this kitchen, the order of operations has gone wrong. Two of us ate, both of us picked, and the bill was seventy dollars.

Really good cooking from a kitchen that clearly enjoys itself. The menu has jokes on it and the food is serious. The pork belly was excellent and the greens were properly seasoned. Service was relaxed and competent. I will definitely return.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The flavors are bold & the seasoning is heavy-handed. Everything I ate was salty, which is a shame, because underneath the salt there were interesting things happening. My friend, who salts everything, thought it was perfect. Depends on your palate.

Genuinely exceptional cooking and one of the best wine lists in the city, full of interesting things at fair prices. The sommelier found us something wonderful for forty-five dollars. The lamb was superb. A really serious restaurant.

Reheated, I am almost certain. The lasagne had that dried edge and the centre was still cool. The salad beside it was dressed hours earlier and had gone limp. It is a shame because the room is warm and the staff are lovely and the food is simply not good.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Perfectly decent food in a room that is too brightly lit to linger in. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The grilled chicken was properly cooked & the rice was fine and the salad was dressed too heavily. Service was quick and impersonal. I would come back for a fast weekday dinner and not for an evening out.

Polite service, clean room, average food. The soup was watery & the main was heavy. I ate here because I work nearby and I will eat here again for the same reason. That is the most honest recommendation I can give and it is not much of one. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. I have a soft spot for this place that I cannot fully justify. The cooking is ordinary, the room is dated & the prices are fair. It is where we went after my first job and we keep going back. The chicken schnitzel is exactly as good as it was. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Outstanding modern Indian cooking. Confident spicing, excellent breads made to order, and dishes that respect the tradition while doing something new. The lamb was superb. Considerably more expensive than a standard curry house and worth the difference.

Ordered six small plates and would order three of them again. The prawns and the flatbread were excellent, the aubergine was good, and the other three were forgettable. That is a reasonable hit rate for a menu like this and the bill was fair.

The place is gorgeous & the food is an afterthought. People come here for the view and the room, which are both genuinely special, and the kitchen knows it does not have to try. My fish was overcooked and nobody who works here would be surprised.

Forty-five dollars for a plate of pasta in a room with paper napkins & a queue for the bathroom. The kitchen is not the problem, the pricing is delusional. The tomato sauce was decent, the portion was tiny, and I was hungry again within the hour.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

My soup arrived with a fly in it. The server removed the bowl, returned with the same soup in a different bowl, and I know it was the same because the garnish was arranged identically. I did not eat it. I did not eat anything else either.

Good produce, honest cooking, & portions that are frankly too small for the price. Three of us shared six dishes and left to get chips on the way home. The flavors were clean and I cannot recommend a restaurant that sends people to a chip shop.

Service was quick & pleasant and the room was comfortable. The food was the problem. My pasta was overcooked to the point of falling apart, and the sauce underneath was sweet in a way that did not belong. My colleague's salad was fresh and well dressed.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Waited fifty minutes for a table we had booked two weeks earlier, then another thirty for food. The lamb was grey and swimming in a sauce that tasted mostly of salt. Nobody apologised. The manager looked right through me when I tried to flag him down.

The menu lives at [URL] & has not been updated in years. Perfect fish and chips. The batter shattered, the fish was fresh and steaming, and the chips had been cooked twice properly. The mushy peas were excellent. We ate on the wall outside looking at the harbour and it was one of the best meals of the holiday.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Decent pho, generous portions, & a broth that could use another few hours. The herbs were fresh and plentiful and the beef was well cut. It is a solid bowl at a fair price and there are two places within a mile doing it better.

This is a restaurant that photographs better than it tastes. Everything arrives looking beautiful and tasting slightly underdone or slightly underseasoned. The room is full every night of people taking pictures of food they then do not finish.

The kitchen is fast & the food is fine. Twenty minutes from ordering to eating for a full plate of grilled meat and rice. It was good rather than memorable and cost nineteen dollars. For a weekday dinner alone at the counter, that is a fair deal.

Being told that a twenty percent service charge is mandatory, after service that consisted of one visit to the table, is a strange way to run a business. The food was average. The attitude about the bill is what I will remember & what I will tell people.

The room is cramped, the food is decent, and the prices are low. All three follow from each other. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The stir fry was well made and the table was tiny and the whole meal cost sixteen dollars. I am not going to complain about any part of that. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The lunch buffet is good value & the quality varies by dish. The dal was excellent, the chicken was dry from sitting, and the naan was made to order and very good. For eighteen dollars including a drink there is nothing to complain about.

Booked for a work lunch & it did the job. Efficient, quiet enough to talk, and the food arrived promptly. The salmon was overcooked and the salad was fine and nobody at the table commented on either. Useful and thoroughly unexciting.

Excellent fish and chips. The batter was light and properly crisp, the fish was fresh, and the chips were cooked twice as they should be. The mushy peas were ordinary. Sitting outside on a warm evening this was a genuinely lovely thing to eat.

I have eaten at a lot of mediocre diners and this one still managed to surprise me. Eggs cold, toast burnt on one side and raw on the other, coffee that had clearly been sitting since morning. The waitress was pleasant, which is the only reason this is not a zero.

The fried fish was excellent & the chips were awful, pale and soft and clearly cooked once. Half the meal was very good. It is the kind of failure that would take one conversation in the kitchen to fix, which makes it more frustrating rather than less. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. Outstanding. The bread arrived warm and was the best I have eaten in a restaurant. Everything after it lived up to it. My lamb was extraordinary and the vegetables were properly seasoned and interesting. The service was warm and completely assured.

Very good meal, slightly chaotic service. Our dishes arrived in a strange order & one was forgotten and then produced quickly. The food itself was excellent, particularly the pork belly. The staff were apologetic and lovely and I did not mind at all. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

The dumplings here are the best I have found in the city and I have looked hard. Thin skins, generous filling, and a chili oil worth ordering extra of. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The room is cramped and loud and I do not care. Four stars only because the service can be brusque.

Booked for an anniversary dinner & regretted it by the appetizer. The bread was stale, the wine list was three options long, and the dining room was so cold my partner kept her coat on the whole meal. Eighty dollars for an evening we both wanted to end early.

Fresh ingredients, visibly, & a kitchen that does not know what to do with them. The salad was crisp and drowned in dressing. The fish was good quality and cooked several minutes too long. It is not carelessness exactly, more a lack of judgement.

I ordered the fish of the day and was served something that had clearly been frozen and rushed. The texture gave it away immediately. When I raised it, the server explained at length why I was wrong. I did not need a lecture, I needed a dinner I could eat.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Good for what it is, which is a fast lunch near the station. The wrap was fresh and the salad was crisp and the whole thing cost nine dollars. It was also bland and I added three sachets of hot sauce. I will keep going and I would not send anyone here.

Very good food and a genuinely kind staff. My daughter is a fussy eater and they went out of their way without making a fuss about it. The cooking was excellent, particularly the fish. The bill was reasonable. We will be regulars.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken

Great pizza, properly blistered base, & toppings used with restraint. The salad we ordered alongside was dressed too heavily and I would skip it next time. Everything else was very good and the staff were genuinely friendly throughout the evening. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The seafood is fresh and handled with real care. The oysters were excellent and the grilled fish was cooked perfectly. Prices are high, which is fair given the quality, and the room is a little formal for my taste. Genuinely good cooking. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Excellent handmade pasta & a menu that changes often enough to keep me coming back. Tonight the ragu was outstanding. The starters are less interesting and I now skip them. Service is warm and a little slow. Very good value for the quality.

I booked for a work dinner and it exceeded everything I hoped. The private room was genuinely private, the service was seamless, and the food was excellent throughout. My client asked for the name twice. The beef course was outstanding.

A genuinely excellent lunch. The soup was properly seasoned & hot, the bread was made in house, and the salad was fresh and well dressed. It took forty minutes, which was longer than I wanted. The quality was high enough that I did not mind much. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

The vegetarian cooking here is better than most places manage with meat. The cauliflower dish was outstanding & the mushroom pasta was very good. The desserts are ordinary. As the only vegetarian in my group I usually eat worst and here I ate best. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

A pleasant enough dinner that cost more than it was worth. Nothing was wrong. The fish was fresh & correctly cooked, the wine was good, the room was comfortable. A hundred and twenty dollars for two and I cannot point to where it went.

A superb evening. Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. The kitchen sent out one excellent plate after another and the service was warm and completely on top of things. The fish was flawless and the dessert was among the best I have had. Expensive and entirely justified by the meal.

Terrible. The pizza base was burnt at the edge & raw where the toppings sat, which takes some doing. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The salad was dressed with something oversweet. The server was apologetic and clearly embarrassed, and I felt worse for her than for us.

A superb meal from a tiny kitchen. One cook, five dishes, everything made with real care. The fish was perfect & the vegetable dish alongside was exceptional. It takes a long time and that is the nature of it. Book ahead and allow the whole evening.

Half of this menu is very good and half is filler. The grilled fish was excellent. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The pasta beside it was ordinary. If you order carefully you will eat well and if you order at random you will have a mixed evening, which is what happened to us.

A proper neighbourhood restaurant. The owner knows everyone, the wine is fairly priced, and the pasta is made in house and it shows. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The gnocchi was light and the ragu was excellent. The room is small and the tables are close together.

Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. They lost our takeout order twice. The first time they claimed it had been collected, the second time they admitted it was never entered. Ninety minutes after ordering I got a bag of cold noodles and an apology so perfunctory it was almost funny.

Really nice room, lovely staff, and a meal that cost two hundred dollars for two and was not worth half of it. The cooking is fussy and underpowered. Tiny portions of very pretty food that tasted of very little. We ate again when we got home.

A solid Tuesday restaurant. Not somewhere I would take a visitor, not somewhere I would avoid. The burger was cooked correctly, the chips were fine, the beer was cold. Twenty-two dollars, forty minutes, home by nine. It served its purpose exactly.. The menu lives at [URL] & has not been updated in years

The bar is excellent and the restaurant is average. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers.
