We ate at the bar, which I recommend, because the bartender is skilled and interesting and the food takes the pressure off the conversation rather than the other way around. The pork buns were good.

Depends entirely what you order. The vegetable dishes here are excellent, properly seasoned and interesting. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The meat is pedestrian. We ordered four of each and could have told you afterwards which kitchen section was having a better night. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Great value, generous portions, & genuinely good cooking. The curry was properly spiced and the rice was perfect. The room is bright and functional with no atmosphere at all, which is the only thing keeping this from a five.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Good quality ingredients and a kitchen that seasons timidly. Everything needed salt. Once salted, the food was genuinely enjoyable, which suggests the cooking is sound and somebody has made a decision about seasoning that I disagree with.

The kitchen is clearly run by somebody who cares about vegetables. The roasted carrots were the best thing on the table and I did not expect to write that. The meat dishes were good too. A short menu, well executed, in a comfortable room. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

The pho here has a broth with real depth, clearly cooked a long time, and the herbs come out fresh and abundant. The beef was well cut. It costs sixteen dollars and is the best bowl in the neighbourhood. The room is cramped and that is my only note.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works

Everything about the experience felt cynical. A menu engineered to upsell, a server pushing the two most expensive items, a wine list with nothing under sixty, & food that did not come close to justifying any of it. We will not be back.

Very enjoyable evening in a restaurant that takes itself just seriously enough. The food was good throughout and the service was relaxed and competent. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. My main was a little underseasoned. Everything else, including the very good wine, was excellent.

The seafood is fresh & simply prepared and slightly overpriced. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The oysters were excellent. The grilled fish was good and cost forty-two dollars. It is a lovely spot by the water and you are partly paying for the view, which is fair enough. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Adequate. The chicken was cooked, the salad was cold, the bill was correct. Nothing to complain about and nothing to remember. For a Tuesday when nothing else was open it did the job and I do not expect to think about it again.

The bar snacks are excellent & the actual dinner menu is a letdown. The anchovies, the almonds, the bread, all perfect. Then a main course of dry lamb with a sauce that tasted of little. Eat standing up at the bar and you will rate this place higher.

Ate here twice this month. The first meal was very good & the second was mediocre, which averages to this. The kitchen seems to depend heavily on who is working. The room and the service are consistent and pleasant either way.

Best barbecue in the region and I have driven a long way to test that. The brisket had a proper bark and a genuine smoke ring and needed no sauce at all. The sides were excellent. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. They sell out early and it is worth arriving before noon.

Came here for years when it was excellent and it is now merely fine. New management, I think. The menu is the same and the cooking has softened. Still a nice room, still friendly, and the pasta no longer has the bite it used to have.

Exceptional Vietnamese food with proper care taken over every component. The herbs are fresh, the pickles are made in house, and the broth is genuinely deep. The banh mi is the best I have found. Cheap, quick, and consistently excellent over years.

Fair prices, big portions, indifferent cooking. The pasta was overcooked by a minute or two & the sauce was perfectly decent. My children ate everything and were delighted. I have had this meal a hundred times and will have it a hundred more.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

Paid a deposit to hold a table of ten, then had the booking cancelled by text the day before with no explanation and no refund offered. I got the deposit back eventually after two phone calls. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The food, on a previous visit, was unremarkable. Now irrelevant.

My partner found a long hair baked into the crust of her pizza. We showed the kitchen and they brought a replacement twenty minutes later with no apology and no adjustment to the bill. I will not be going back and I have told everyone I know.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

The kitchen is inconsistent in a way that makes it hard to recommend. Our table of four had two excellent dishes and two poor ones, and we ordered from the same section of the menu. Whoever is on the grill is having a better night than whoever is on the pass.

The kitchen has one very good dish and I recommend it without reservation. Everything else we tried was ordinary. The braised short rib is worth the trip. The sides are an afterthought, the appetizers are dull, and the desserts come from somewhere else.

The gnocchi was heavy and the ragu on top of it was outstanding. That has been true every time I have eaten here. Somebody in that kitchen makes a wonderful sauce and somebody else makes the pasta. I keep ordering it and keep having the same reaction.

The room is much nicer than the food, which is fine because we came for the room. Good light, comfortable chairs, a view of the park. The chicken was adequate and the potatoes were good. For a long lunch with a friend it worked perfectly well.

Genuinely exceptional Sichuan cooking with no compromises. The numbing heat is real and properly balanced. The dry-fried green beans were extraordinary and the mapo tofu was the best I have had. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Cheap, loud, fast, and completely wonderful. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Very good cooking in a room that is genuinely beautiful. Old tiles, good light, comfortable chairs. The food matched it, particularly the fish and the bread. The service was slightly slow and always warm. A lovely place for a long lunch.

Ordered delivery three times and got three different levels of quality. Tonight was the worst: cold, late, and missing the side. The restaurant is good when you eat in, which I know from experience. Something about the delivery operation is not working.

Pleasant garden, decent drinks, and food that is clearly coming out of a very small kitchen under pressure. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. Everything took a long time and arrived warm rather than hot. The burgers were fine. On a sunny afternoon none of it mattered much, which is my point. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Very good service from a young team who were clearly new and clearly trying. The food did not support them. My main was underseasoned and my partner's arrived fifteen minutes later. Two stars for the kitchen, five for the floor, and I have averaged.

Very good food, very slow kitchen. Ninety minutes for two courses. I would normally mark that down harder and the cooking was good enough to forgive it. The short rib was excellent. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Bring somebody you want to talk to and do not book before a film. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The meal was fine & the aftermath was not. Charged twice, spent three weeks chasing it, and was eventually told to take it up with my bank. That is not how this works. I will not eat somewhere that treats its own billing errors as somebody else's problem.

An hour and a half for two courses on a quiet Wednesday. The pacing was the problem, not the cooking, which was decent throughout. The lamb was good. We had somewhere to be and spent the last half hour watching the door for our server. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Good ingredients treated respectfully and without much imagination. The steak was well sourced and correctly cooked and served with a plain salad. That is the whole dish and it costs forty-four dollars. Some people want exactly that. I wanted a bit more.

Genuinely the best coffee in the neighbourhood and the food is excellent too. The pastries are properly laminated and the eggs are cooked to order. I have been going most mornings for two years. The staff know my order and the quality has never dipped.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Solid cooking let down by the room, which is cramped and hot and smells strongly of the fryer. My clothes needed washing afterwards. The food was genuinely good, particularly the pork, and I would order it again for collection rather than eat in. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. A perfect neighbourhood restaurant. The menu is short, the cooking is careful, the prices are fair and the room is comfortable. The fish was excellent and the vegetables were properly seasoned. We have been going for three years and it never slips.

Outstanding from the first plate. The kitchen is doing careful, personal cooking and every dish had a clear idea behind it. The vegetable courses were as good as the meat, which is rare. The wine list is interesting and honestly priced. Superb.

Excellent bakery attached to a decent cafe. The bread is outstanding and the pastries are as good as anything in the city. The sandwiches are good without being special. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. I come twice a week and buy a loaf and occasionally stay for coffee.

Very good food and terrible parking, which is not their fault. Once inside, the meal was excellent. The pork belly was properly crisp and the greens were good. Service was warm throughout. We will come back and get a taxi.

Somewhere between a cafe and a restaurant and not entirely convincing as either. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The lunch menu is good. The dinner menu is the same food with candles and higher prices. The soup was excellent both times and the mains have never impressed me. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

The tacos are excellent, the tortillas are made in house, and the salsas are worth the trip on their own. The room is tiny and you will probably stand. Four stars because the queue at peak is unreasonable and the food is genuinely very good.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

This is proper Vietnamese cooking with nothing cut short. The broth has been going for hours and tastes like it, the herbs are abundant and fresh, and the beef is well cut. Sixteen dollars for a bowl I would happily pay thirty for. Consistently superb.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The bartender poured my drink, forgot it, poured another for somebody else, then gave me the first one after the ice had melted. That set the tone. The kitchen sent out the wrong entree and argued about it. I am not usually someone who writes reviews. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Nothing to complain about and nothing to praise. The tempura was light, the sashimi was fresh, the miso was ordinary. The prices are fair for what it is. I ate well and I did not think about the meal again until I sat down to write this.

Best Sunday roast in the city. Everything was right: the beef was rested & pink, the potatoes were crisp, the Yorkshire puddings were light, and the gravy had real depth. We booked for four and stayed all afternoon. Nobody rushed us at all.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The bibimbap was good & the banchan were excellent and the service was rushed to the point of rudeness. We were seated, ordered, served and cleared in thirty-five minutes. I understand it is a busy lunch spot. I would still like to finish a meal. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The bar staff were pouring shots for themselves while a room full of tables waited for drinks. I am not a killjoy but our order took thirty-five minutes & two of the four drinks were wrong. The kitchen was similarly unhurried. Food arrived cold.

The best Ethiopian food I have found here. The injera was fresh & sour and the stews were deep and varied. The doro wat was exceptional. The family who run it made us feel like guests rather than customers. Generous portions at low prices. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

The pierogi were clearly frozen & clearly boiled too long, because several had burst and the filling was floating in the water they brought them in. The sour cream was the only component that worked. My grandmother would have had something to say.

Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. An hour & ten minutes for a pizza in a half-empty restaurant. When it arrived the base was raw in the centre and the cheese had not properly melted. My son, who eats pizza in any condition, left half. That is the most damning thing I can report.

Good cooking, awkward room. The tables are too close and the acoustics are hard, so a full house is a wall of noise. The lamb was genuinely very good and I spent most of the meal leaning across the table. Worth it for a quiet weeknight, not a weekend.

Menu says handmade pasta. What we ate was clearly from a packet, overcooked and sitting in a watery tomato sauce that had never met a fresh tomato. I would have accepted it at half the price from a cafe. From a place calling itself a trattoria it is insulting.

A genuinely exceptional meal. Everything was properly seasoned, everything arrived at the right temperature, and the whole thing was paced beautifully. The scallops were perfect and the dessert was outstanding. Our server was excellent throughout.

Serviceable. The chicken was cooked through and slightly dry, the vegetables were fine, the potatoes were good. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. I ate it, I paid, I left. My colleague described it as perfectly adequate and I have not been able to improve on that summary.

Very good tapas and an excellent wine list, short and thoughtfully chosen. The tortilla was properly runny in the middle. Only the patatas bravas disappointed. We ate and drank well for eighty dollars and stayed longer than we meant to. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

Booked a month ahead for a birthday, mentioned the occasion twice, & got nothing but a bill. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. Fine, that is not obligatory. What is less fine is that the duck was tough, the sauce was cloying, and the vegetables arrived twenty minutes after the meat.

Excellent produce, cooked lightly and well. The tomatoes in the salad were the best I have eaten this year & the bread was fresh from the oven. The main courses are simpler than I expected for the price. Everything was good and some of it was special.

Best Sunday lunch in the area by a distance. The beef was perfect, the potatoes were properly crisp, the greens were good, and the gravy was made from bones. We booked at two and stayed until five and nobody hurried us. Exactly right.

Old-fashioned in a way that is sometimes charming and sometimes just dated. The prawn cocktail was genuinely good. The sole was drowned in butter and the vegetables were boiled. My father loved it. I can see both sides and I have landed in the middle.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

Ordered two mains and a side. One main arrived. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Twenty minutes later the side arrived. The second main never did, and when we asked for the bill they had charged for it anyway. I have had worse food but I have rarely had worse organisation.

They charge for tap water. Not sparkling, tap. Four dollars. That would be a footnote if the food were good, but the chicken was dry and the rice underneath it was hard, so instead it becomes the summary. This place does not respect its customers.

The prawns were still frozen in the middle. I want to be clear that this is not an exaggeration or a figure of speech. I bit into ice. The server took them away and the manager came over to explain that the kitchen had been very busy. It was not busy.

Good sourdough, indifferent everything else. The bakery side of this business is excellent and the cafe side is coasting. My sandwich had two slices of tomato and a lot of bread. For eleven dollars I expected the filling to be the point. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. Went on a Tuesday when nothing else nearby was open, and I now understand why this place always is. The chicken was dry, the gravy was gluey, and the vegetables had been boiled into submission. Cheap, filling, and genuinely unpleasant to eat.

Solid neighbourhood pizza, nothing more. The base was decent, the toppings were sparse, & the whole thing was underseasoned. My children were perfectly happy. I would order from here again on a night when I did not care, which is a real category.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Perfect for what it is, which is a small, warm, family-run place doing honest food extremely well. The stew had been cooking all day. The bread was made that morning. The owner remembers everyone. Cheap, generous, and among my favourite places anywhere.

The tasting menu was interesting rather than delicious. A lot of ideas, several of which did not land, & two courses I thought were genuinely brilliant. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. At this price I want a higher proportion of brilliance and I respect the attempt.

A kitchen that is technically careful and emotionally absent. Every element on the plate was correctly executed and the whole thing was joyless. The fish was cooked precisely. The sauce was balanced. I finished it and felt nothing at all about the experience.. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years

Great little wine bar with food much better than it needs to be. The cheese and charcuterie are well chosen and the hot dishes are genuinely good. The croquetas were excellent. Seating is uncomfortable after an hour, which limits the evening.. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

The photographs on their site show generous plates of barbecue. What arrived was four thin slices of dry brisket & a spoonful of beans. When I asked whether that was the full portion the server shrugged. Charging that much for that little is simply dishonest.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Very good food in a very loud room. Everything we ate was excellent, particularly the pork, & I lost half the conversation. If they fixed the acoustics this would be one of my favourite places in the city. As it is, I come with one person, not four.

An average meal in a restaurant that clearly used to be better. The bones of something good are still visible in the menu. The execution has softened & the prices have not. The waiter has been there fifteen years and is the best thing about it.

The seafood pasta had plenty of seafood and a sauce that tasted mostly of cream. Not bad, not what I wanted. My partner's risotto was better. The room is pleasant and the prices are reasonable and I have no strong feelings in either direction.

The pastries here are exceptional & the savoury food is merely good. The croissants are properly laminated and worth queuing for. I have eaten lunch here twice and it was fine both times. Come in the morning and you will rate this five stars.

Came for the famous burger and it was good, not remarkable. The patty was well seasoned and the bun was soft and the whole thing needed more acidity. Everyone I know raves about it. I ate mine, enjoyed it, and did not understand the fuss.

Excellent fried chicken, properly brined & very crisp. The sides were good, particularly the slaw. It is a small place with a queue and limited seating. The prices have crept up over the last year. The chicken remains the best in the area.

Terrible value. Small plates that were genuinely small, priced as though the ingredients were rare, and none of them memorable. Eight dishes between two people and we both left hungry. The wine markup is the steepest I have seen in this city.

The best cheap meal in the area without question. Twelve dollars for hand pulled noodles in a genuinely deep broth with properly braised pork. You sit at a counter and eat in ten minutes. I go at least twice a week and have never tired of it.

Solid, unpretentious, and slightly tired. The menu has not changed in years and neither has the carpet. The roast lamb was good and the vegetables were overcooked, exactly as they were the last four times. There is comfort in that, up to a point. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

The kitchen clearly cares about vegetables and not much about anything else. The roasted cauliflower was the best thing on the table. The meat dishes were all slightly overcooked and the desserts were heavy. I would come back and eat only from the sides menu. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

This is a wonderful restaurant. The cooking is precise & generous, the menu changes with the season, and the staff are warm and knowledgeable. Tonight the fish was perfect. We have been coming for two years and it has never once disappointed.

Somebody has decided that every dish needs truffle oil. Every dish. The pasta, the fries, the chicken, and, inexplicably, the salad. After the second course it is all you can taste. The cooking underneath might be competent and I will never know.. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

The meal was fine & the wine list was excellent, which shifted the evening upwards. We drank better than we ate. The fish was competently cooked and the sides were dull. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The sommelier was the best thing about the place by a considerable distance. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The music was so loud that our server had to lean in and shout the specials, and we still missed half of them. We ordered blind. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. What came was fine, forgettable pub food, but I could not tell you what half of it was meant to be. Not an evening, an endurance test.

A local favourite that I find merely okay. Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. Everybody I know loves this place. The food is generous and warm and a bit sloppy. The lasagne was good and swimming. I think I am wrong about it and I am reporting what I actually thought. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

The kitchen sent out four dishes in eleven minutes, which sounds efficient and meant we ate everything at once in a rush. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. Nothing was bad. The sea bass was good. It felt less like dinner and more like a delivery, and we were out in forty minutes.

Exceptional coffee and food that matches it. The eggs are properly cooked, the bread is made in house, and the pastries are as good as anywhere in the city. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. It is small and busy and the people behind the counter are genuinely lovely.

The number on the door is [PHONE] & somebody actually answers. Ordered the special and the standard dish and the standard dish was better, which is unusual. The special was overworked and the regular pasta was clean and simple and good. I will ignore the specials board in future and be happier for it.

Came in for a quiet lunch and got a table beside a birthday party of twenty. Entirely bad luck. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The food was middling anyway, a passable soup and a heavy sandwich, so I cannot blame the noise for the review. I would try again on a quieter day, probably.

A competent kitchen in a difficult room. The space is long and narrow and half the tables are in a corridor. We were in the corridor. The food was good, particularly the starters, and the experience of eating it was not especially pleasant.

Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. The queue was forty minutes and I want that time back. The burger was overcooked to the point of crumbling, the bun was dry, and the fries were limp. Everyone around us seemed delighted, which makes me think I am missing something, but I ate what I ate.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Cheap, fast, and not very good. The falafel was dry through the middle, the hummus was grainy, and the flatbread was clearly reheated. The pickles and the sauces were excellent. I ate the whole thing and I was not glad about it.

Outstanding Nigerian food & a welcome that made the evening. The jollof was exceptional and the stew had real depth. The portions are enormous and the prices are low. The family who run it came out to check on us twice. Genuinely wonderful.

A reasonable meal in a very loud room. The food was good and I could not hear my companion, which for a first date was a real problem. We moved to a bar afterwards and had a much better time. I would come back here alone or not at all.

The tacos themselves were fine, maybe better than fine, but everything around them dragged the meal down. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Cold plates, a missing side, & a server who took our order and then vanished. I have had a very good meal here before which makes this harder to write.

Two good dishes, two dull ones, and a bill that was higher than I expected. The crab was excellent and the flatbread was very good. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. The other half of the order was forgettable. I now know what to order here and I am not certain I will return to order it. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

The shakshuka was watery, the bread was dry, & the coffee was served in a glass that was too hot to hold. Simple things, all done badly. The place is packed every weekend and I have stopped trying to understand why. Not for me and not again.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

The ramen is exceptional. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The broth has been cooked properly and for a long time and you can taste every hour of it. The noodles have real bite and the egg was flawless. I have been to a lot of ramen places and this is the one I keep returning to.

Exceptional Greek food and a genuinely warm welcome. The lamb had been cooking all day and fell apart. The salad was fresh and properly dressed and the bread came out of the oven. The owner sat down with us at the end. Generous in every sense.

The room was freezing and the staff were apologetic about it, which does not make it warmer. We ate quickly and left. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The food was decent, a well-made pasta and a reasonable salad, and I could not tell you much more because I was concentrating on being cold.

Three of us, three different opinions. My brother thought it was the best Thai food he had eaten in the city, I thought it was sweet and mild, and my wife barely touched hers. I suspect the truth is that it is a decent restaurant cooking for a broad audience.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Very good food and a slightly strange room, long and narrow with the kitchen at the far end. The cooking is excellent, particularly the pasta, and the service is warm. I would go back and ask for a table near the front, away from the door.. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine

An outstanding restaurant. The cooking is generous and precise, the room is comfortable and warm, and the staff are genuinely pleased you came. The short rib was extraordinary. The prices are fair for the quality. We will be back very soon.

Exceptional pizza & genuinely good salads, which almost nobody manages. The base is properly fermented and blistered, and the toppings are excellent and used sparingly. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Loud, cheerful, and cheap. I have eaten here more than anywhere else this year.

Standard, reliable, unexciting. I have ordered the same thing here for two years because it is always the same. That consistency is genuinely valuable and it is not the same as being good. Fourteen dollars, ready in fifteen minutes, always fine.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. Fair prices, good beer, tired food. The pie had a soggy bottom and the mash was clearly instant. The pub itself is a genuinely nice place to spend an evening, with a good fire and a landlord who talks to everybody. I would drink here and eat elsewhere.

The barbecue is good without being exceptional. The brisket had a decent bark and was slightly dry at the ends. Sides were generous and unremarkable. In a city with real competition this sits comfortably in the middle of the pack, which is no shame.

Their booking address is [EMAIL] & it actually works. Very good food and a genuinely excellent sommelier who found us something interesting for forty dollars. The lamb was excellent. The starters were less exciting than the mains. A lovely evening and we will be back for the wine as much as the food.

Thirty-five dollars for a bowl of pasta that arrived at room temperature with a sauce that had split. I flagged it and was told that is the style. It is not the style. I have eaten this dish in four countries and it has never been served cold and broken.

A deeply mediocre meal delivered with real confidence. The server described the sourcing of every ingredient at length. None of that showed up on the plate, where a piece of overcooked cod sat on a puddle of thin sauce. Style with nothing underneath.

Excellent for what it is, which is a fast, cheap, very well made bowl of food. The rice was perfect & the pork was properly caramelised. Ten minutes from ordering to eating. It is a lunch spot and it is one of the best I know.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers

Warm welcome, cold food. Two of our three mains arrived at a temperature that suggested a wait on the pass, & the third was piping hot, which makes it worse rather than better. The flavors, once you got past the temperature, were good.

Three courses in seventy minutes, which suited us, and none of them worth much comment. The kitchen is efficient and unambitious. My chicken was correctly cooked and dull, and the sauce beside it was a bit sweet. A useful restaurant rather than a good one.

Everything was thirty percent more expensive than it was a year ago & no better. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The burger is now twenty-six dollars and comes without chips. It is a good burger. It is not a twenty-six dollar burger, and the room has not changed at all.

Takeout arrived twenty minutes early, which was a pleasant surprise, & cold, which was not. The curry had a skin on it. The flavor underneath was good and the rice was well cooked. I reheated it and it was fine. That should not be the customer's job.

The tasting menu was genuinely delightful for eight of its ten courses. Two were forgettable. The opening sequence of small cold plates was some of the most interesting food I have eaten all year. Excellent value for what it is & I will go back.

The cheapest way I can describe this meal is that I would not have eaten it if somebody else had cooked it for free. Greasy, salty, and dull. The bread was the best thing on the table and it came out of a bag. My colleague and I now avoid this whole street.

Genuinely good barbecue in a city that does not do much of it. The ribs were excellent & the brisket was very good. The sides were ordinary. The room is casual and the portions are generous and the prices are fair for the quality.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

The cooking here is precise and generous at once, which is a difficult combination. My short rib was extraordinary and my partner's fish was equally good. The bread was excellent and the wine was well chosen. We will be coming back regularly.

Best brunch in the city and I have tried most of them. The eggs were perfect, the hollandaise was made to order, and the sourdough is baked on site. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. The coffee is excellent. There is a queue at weekends and it is worth standing in.

Found a piece of plastic in my rice. Actual plastic, about the size of a fingernail. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Showed the server, who took the plate away and came back to say the kitchen was not sure how that happened. Neither am I, and I am not going to find out by returning.

Genuinely superb Thai cooking with real heat & real balance. The papaya salad was fierce and fresh, the curry had proper depth, and the noodles were excellent. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. Nothing was sweetened down. Cheap, fast, and better than anywhere else nearby.

Really good food & a slightly rushed experience. We were in and out in seventy minutes for three courses, which was more than we wanted. The cooking was excellent, particularly the beef. On a quieter night I suspect this would be a five star review.

Exceptional pizza. The base has had a proper long ferment and the difference is enormous, light and blistered and chewy. Toppings used sparingly and well. Twenty minutes from ordering to eating. I have eaten here perhaps thirty times. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Slow, friendly, decent. A long lunch that became a longer lunch because nothing arrived quickly. The food was good when it came, particularly the salad, and the wine was cheap. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. If you are in no hurry it is a pleasant way to spend two hours.

Outstanding Gujarati thali. Fifteen or so small dishes, all of them distinct & well spiced, and they keep refilling until you stop them. The dal was exceptional. Twenty-two dollars and I could not eat for the rest of the day. Genuinely wonderful.

Portions are generous and the price is fair, which counts for something. The problem is that nothing tasted of very much. The stew was hearty and bland, the rice was plentiful and plain. I left full and with the sense that I had not really eaten anything.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Beautiful plating, average flavors, & a server who talked us through every dish in unnecessary detail. The fish was well cooked and underseasoned. The dessert was a genuine highlight. It is a restaurant trying to be fine dining at bistro prices.

The fish and chips were good and the mushy peas were excellent and the batter was slightly heavy. Sitting outside by the harbour on a warm evening it did not matter at all. I suspect in a plastic tray in the rain I would rate this differently.

Excellent cooking and a menu that changes with what they can get, which I like. Tonight the fish was outstanding. The vegetables were very good. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. The room is comfortable and the staff explain the dishes well without lecturing. Very good value.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. We ate here on our anniversary and it was perfect. Every dish was excellent, the wine the sommelier chose was inspired, and the service was warm and completely unobtrusive. The duck was the best I have eaten. Expensive, memorable, and worth it.

The seafood is clearly fresh and the kitchen clearly overcooks it. My prawns were rubbery, the fish was dry, and the mussels, which were excellent, showed what the place is capable of when it gets the timing right. It got the timing right once. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Dinner was slow, warm & pleasant until the bill arrived with a service charge we had not been told about and two drinks we had not ordered. Follow [HANDLE] for better photos than mine. It took ten minutes to fix and the manager was gracious. The food had been average and now it is what I remember least.

Great for a group, less good as a meal. We were eight and they handled us well, split the bill without complaint, and kept the drinks coming. The food was uniformly average. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. If I were eating alone I would go almost anywhere else nearby. The espresso cost 3.50, which is reasonable around here.

Delicious chili oil, great atmosphere, and dumplings with skins so thick they were difficult to chew. The filling was well seasoned. My friend liked hers more than I liked mine. We will probably try somewhere else next time rather than order differently.

A really solid neighbourhood Indian with one exceptional dish. The lamb bhuna is worth crossing town for. The rest of the menu is good without being remarkable. The staff are warm and remember regulars and the prices have stayed reasonable.

I cannot decide about this place. The cooking is skilled & the portions are small and the prices are high and the room is genuinely beautiful. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. Every element is arguable. I have been twice and both times left thinking I would need a third visit to know.

Food poisoning is a strong accusation so I will just say that three of us ate the chicken & three of us spent the following day at home. The kitchen is visible from the dining room and what I could see of it did not inspire confidence.. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation

Very good brunch and a long wait. Forty minutes standing outside and then excellent eggs, properly made hollandaise, and very good coffee. It is the best brunch nearby and the queue is the price. On a weekday I would call it five stars.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers

The best tapas I have eaten outside Spain. The tortilla was properly runny, the croquetas had a liquid centre, & the jamon was excellent. The wine list is short and all Spanish and very fairly priced. Loud, warm, and completely delightful.

Adequate food, lovely terrace. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. In summer this is a four star experience and the food has nothing to do with it. Tonight the pasta was fine and the wine was cold and the sun was out. In January I would not bother and I doubt they are open.

The kitchen here does simple things better than anywhere else nearby. A whole grilled fish with lemon & good oil, a salad, some bread. That is the meal and it was perfect. The produce is exceptional and the cooking gets out of its way.

Exceptional Korean cooking with nothing toned down. The stew was properly fiery & had real depth, and the banchan were varied and generous. The fried chicken was outstanding. Service is fast and warm. It gets very busy and it is worth the wait.

Reasonable food, unreasonable wait. Ninety minutes from sitting down to eating on a night when the restaurant was two-thirds empty. The pasta was good when it came. Nothing about the food was worth the time & I had somewhere to be. They are on version 2.0 of the menu now.

The sushi was fine & the rice was too warm, which for me is a real problem. My companion did not notice and enjoyed her meal. Their booking address is [EMAIL] and it actually works. The fish quality is good and the prices are fair. I am probably fussier than most and I would not order it again.

A decent meal and a strange atmosphere. The restaurant was almost empty on a Friday and the staff outnumbered the diners. Everything was fine and slightly awkward. The food was good, the lamb especially. I hope they are doing better than it looked.

Perfectly good food served without any warmth at all. The staff are efficient & unsmiling and the room is functional. The dumplings were excellent. I have eaten here a dozen times and never once had a conversation with anybody who works there.

Service with real contempt in it. We asked for the wine list and were told to use the QR code. We asked about the specials and were pointed at a board across the room. The kitchen was fine. The front of house made it clear we were an inconvenience.

Excellent cooking and a slightly sterile room. The food is genuinely very good, particularly the seafood, and the space feels like a corporate dining room. If they warmed up the interior this would be an easy five. The staff are lovely.. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown

Adequate in every direction. The service was neither warm nor cold, the food was neither good nor bad, and the bill was neither cheap nor expensive. The menu lives at [URL] and has not been updated in years. I have rarely eaten a meal that provoked so little reaction. My colleague said the same thing unprompted.

Very good food & a long queue for a small room. Once in, the cooking was excellent, particularly the aubergine and the lamb. The staff are efficient and the turnover is fast. It is not a place to linger and the food is very much worth the visit.

Everything I want from a neighbourhood restaurant. The cooking is careful, the prices are honest, the room is comfortable and the staff are genuinely pleased to see you. The stew tonight was excellent and the bread was still warm. We go monthly.

We came for a birthday and the whole team made it feel like an occasion without any of the usual awkwardness. The food was excellent throughout, particularly the beef. The wine our server suggested was perfect. Everyone at the table has asked to go back.

A lovely evening. Good food, good wine, & a server who was interesting without being intrusive. My fish was excellent and my wife's chicken was slightly dry. The dessert we shared was very good. Four stars and we are going back next month.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Very good food & a slightly pushy upsell on the wine, which soured the start of the evening. The cooking more than recovered it. The lamb was excellent and the vegetables were properly done. Our server improved considerably once we ordered.

A very good steakhouse without the theatre. The meat is well sourced and properly rested and the sides are simple and good. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Prices are high and transparent. The room is dark and comfortable. I have taken three different people and all enjoyed it.

The single thing this restaurant does well is the room, which is beautiful. Everything that happens inside it is a letdown. Slow service, a kitchen that cannot time a table, & a bill that assumes you were too charmed to notice any of the above.

The bibimbap arrived without the egg, without the gochujang, and lukewarm. It was, essentially, a bowl of plain rice and vegetables. When I asked for the missing components the server brought the egg, cold, on a side plate. I gave up and ate what I could.

The food was fine and the portion sizes were inconsistent across the table, which was odd. My plate had noticeably less on it than my friend's identical order. Neither of us said anything. Both dishes tasted good. Small thing, and I noticed it.

Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details. The one-star is for the hygiene, not the cooking. There was visible grease on the wall beside our table & the salt shaker was sticky enough to leave a mark on my hand. Once you notice that, you stop being able to enjoy anything that arrives.

I ate here twice, once good and once like this, and the second visit was so bad it cancels the first. Burnt garlic through the whole dish, a raw middle on the chicken, and a server who took the plate away without asking why I had eaten two bites.

Exceptional dim sum, particularly the har gow, which had wrappers thin enough to see the prawn through. Everything arrived hot & quickly. We ate for an hour and the bill for four was eighty dollars. The best Sunday lunch we have had in ages.

For a place attached to a petrol station the food is remarkably decent. I say that with genuine surprise. The burger was well made & the coffee was drinkable. It is not a destination and if you are driving past at lunchtime you could do far worse. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Ordered the set lunch which is very good value at eighteen dollars. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The value is the point, because the food was ordinary. Soup, a small main, and a coffee. All fine, none of it good. I will go back when I want to spend eighteen dollars and not think. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

Best barbecue I have eaten outside Texas. Call [PHONE] to book, because the online system is broken. Proper smoke ring, bark you can hear, and brisket that needed nothing on it. The sides are genuinely good rather than an afterthought, particularly the beans. They sell out by two and I understand why.

The chef sends out one exceptional dish & several ordinary ones, and I think that is deliberate. The signature plate is genuinely special. Everything around it exists to fill a menu. I would come back and order the one thing and a lot of bread. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Genuinely good bread, genuinely good olives, and then a main course that arrived so oversalted I could not finish it. I mentioned it and they took it off the bill without argument, which I appreciated. It does not change the fact that I left hungry.

Good soup, poor bread, cheap prices. The soup is made fresh daily and is consistently excellent. The bread that comes with it is clearly from a bag and slightly stale. I have started bringing my own roll, which the owner thinks is hilarious.. Full writeup at [URL] if you want the details

This place is wonderful. Warm room, generous cooking, and prices that have stayed fair while everywhere else has climbed. The stew was excellent and the bread was homemade. The owner remembers us. We have been coming for six years. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. The sushi tasted off. Not dramatically, but that faint sourness you learn to notice. I stopped after two pieces. My friend finished hers and texted me at midnight to say she wished she had not. For these prices the fish should be beyond question.

A cafe that cannot make coffee is a puzzle. Bitter, scalded, & served in a cup that had been through a dishwasher without quite getting clean. The pastry was yesterday's and they did not pretend otherwise. I do not understand how this place stays open.

Outstanding value & outstanding food. Fifteen dollars for a plate of grilled meat, rice and salad, all of it properly made. The marinade has real depth. The room is spartan and the service is fast. It is the best cheap meal I know of. They handed me a printout called menu.pdf instead of a menu.

Friendly staff, genuinely warm welcome, and a dining room I liked immediately. Then the food arrived. The risotto was gluey and the fish on top was dry. It is frustrating because everything around the cooking is right and the cooking is the part that matters. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

The oysters were warm. I sent them back. The replacements were also warm. At that point I stopped, ate some bread, and watched my friends work through a seafood tower I did not trust. Nobody got sick, which feels like luck rather than kitchen practice. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

I have been sceptical about the hype and I was wrong. The tacos are exceptional. The tortillas are pressed to order and the al pastor comes off a proper trompo. The salsas are made fresh and are worth the trip alone. Eight dollars and I ordered six. We waited 45 minutes for a table we had reserved.

Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. Our server was clearly overwhelmed & I felt for her, but the kitchen sent out one wrong dish after another and nobody in charge seemed to be doing anything about it. We got two of the four mains we ordered. We paid for all four and I only noticed later. Meet me @ the cafe on the corner with the green awning.

Excellent cocktails & a kitchen that holds up its end. The bar snacks were very good and the mains were better than they needed to be. We ate at the bar and had a genuinely good evening. Prices are on the high side and the quality is there.

An exceptional meal in a room I did not want to leave. Old tiles, good light, and a kitchen doing precise, restrained cooking. My fish was flawless and the vegetables alongside it were as good as the fish. The bread and butter alone are worth coming for.

The best Oaxacan food I have found here by a considerable distance. The mole negro has real complexity and the tortillas are pressed to order. The staff explained everything properly. Email me at [EMAIL] if you want the full menu breakdown. Small room, long queue, and absolutely worth the wait.

Ordered the tasting menu and enjoyed about half of it. The opening courses were sharp and clever. Then it settled into a run of rich, brown dishes that all tasted broadly similar, and by the end I was tired rather than delighted. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The service was flawless.

The coffee was excellent & the cake was dry. Credit to [HANDLE] for the recommendation. That is an unusual combination and it has happened both times I have been. Somebody here cares a great deal about one thing and not at all about the other. I now come for a flat white and nothing else.

Decent tapas, terrible acoustics. The croquetas were excellent & the tortilla was dry. Everything else was somewhere in between. We shouted at each other for two hours and left with sore throats. The wine list is short and well chosen and reasonably priced. I rated it 9.5 out of 10 overall.

A good cafe with bad lunches. The coffee is properly made and the cakes are excellent, and then the sandwiches are assembled hours ahead and sit in a fridge until somebody buys one. The bread goes hard at the edges. Stick to the baked goods.

A very good meal with one weak course. The starters and mains were excellent, particularly the lamb, and the dessert was ordinary. The room is comfortable, the service is attentive, and the bill was reasonable. I have already recommended it to two people.

Unpleasant from the outset. We were told we had the table for ninety minutes, reminded of it twice during the meal, and then asked to move to the bar at the eighty-minute mark while we were still eating dessert. The food did not justify any of that.. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers

Ate well without enjoying myself much. The food was good & the room was bright and hard and the music was loud. I finished everything and left with a headache. On a quieter night with softer lighting I suspect this would be a different review. My order 5550147 was late by half an hour.

We ate very well. Four small plates, all good, two of them excellent. The whipped cod and the flatbread were the standouts. The bill came to a hundred dollars for two, which felt like a lot for the quantity, and the quality justified most of it.

A family-run place that has been here thirty years and deserves every one of them. The lamb is slow cooked all day and falls apart. The owner's mother makes the bread. Generous, warm, cheap, and genuinely delicious. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. I take everyone who visits. The board said 5@10 for the oyster deal.

Outstanding. I have eaten in a lot of expensive restaurants and few of them made me as happy as this one. The cooking is generous and precise and the flavors are bold. The short rib was extraordinary. The number on the door is [PHONE] and somebody actually answers. The service was excellent throughout.
